Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House

quests.description:
Go talk to Heena.
I met Heena, who's worried the sun is damaging her skin. I should get her mirror from her sister, Sera, so she can check.
Heena asked me to get a mirror from her sister, so I walked all the way to Sera.
quests.name: Borrowing Sera's Mirror

quests.description:
It seems like Olaf in Lith Harbor has something to say to the beginner adventurers who have just arrived on Victoria Island.
I met Olaf at Lith Harbor. Olaf mentioned that I could get a job advancement once I reach level 10, but he wasn't sure if I truly have what it takes. To prove myself, Olaf told me to hunt monsters outside the village. I'm a bit nervous, since the monsters on Victoria Island seem really strong...
I successfully passed Olaf's training. But is this really enough
quests.name: Olaf's First Training
quests.requirements: Defeat Stump x 8, Defeat Slime x 8

quests.description:
It seems Phil, the informant of Lith Harbor, has something to say to all novice adventurers who have just arrived on Victoria Island.
Phil, the informant of Lith Harbor, explained that once you reach Level 10, you can make a job advancement in each town of Victoria Island. They asked me to help out the townsfolk in Lith Harbor and hunt monsters to reach Level 10, then return.
After reaching Level 10, I was able to get information about the job advancement from Phil. It seems you can advance to a Warrior in Perion, a Magician in Ellinia, an Archer in Henesys, and a Thief in Perion. Talking to Phil will allow you to go straight to your town of choice. Since a job advancement cannot be undone once made, I'd better choose carefully...
quests.name: Phil's Call

quests.description:
Look for Jane in Lith Harbor.
I met a girl wearing bunny ears named Jane in Lith Harbor. Jane said she wants to travel the world, but her dad won't let her. She thinks if I get her 15 Blue Mushroom Caps and 15 Horny Mushroom Caps, her father will change his mind.
I delivered the Blue Mushroom Caps and Horny Mushroom Caps to Jane. I wonder if this will really change her father's mind... She's wearing bunny ears, for goodness' sake! Ah well, it's none of my business. In return, Jane gave me a scroll for ATT. My weapon's going to be awesome... if the scroll works.
quests.name: Jane and the Mushroom
quests.requirements: Defeat Blue Mushroom x 30, Defeat Horny Mushroom x 30, Blue Mushroom Cap x 15, Horny Mushroom Cap x 15

items.name: One-Handed Blunt Weapon Attack Scroll: Intermediate

Two-handed Blunt Weapon Attack Scroll: Intermediate

quests.description:
I hear Jane's found herself a new life ambition...
Last time, I got Jane some mushroom caps to help convince her dad to let her travel. Apparently, it didn't work. Now, she has a new dream: she wants to be an alchemist! A bit fickle, but whatever. She told me she needed certain materials to pursue her dreams... and I already knew exactly what she was going to ask for. She wants me to collect 1 Pure Water, 25 Drake Skull, and 25 Medicine With Weird Vibes by defeating monsters, so she can make some Elixirs.
I got the materials Jane needed to make some Elixirs. If she fails... is the whole place going to blow up
quests.name: Jane's First Challenge
quests.requirements: Defeat Copper Drake x 50, Defeat Wraith x 50, Pure Water x 1, Drake Skull x 25, Medicine With Weird Vibes x 25

quests.description:
Jane says she will make me something even better.
This time, Jane promised to make me an even better item than last time, but she needs me to defeat some monsters and gather 1 Mushmom Spore, 3 vials of Drake's Blood, 25 Medicine With Weird Vibes, and 25 Malady's Experimental Frogs. She claimed that she'll be able to use these ingredients to make a more powerful elixir...
I got Jane the materials she needed. If she does well, I'll get some nice elixirs. If not... er, I wonder if I HAVE to take what she makes me...
quests.name: Jane's Second Challenge
quests.requirements: Defeat Wraith x 50, Defeat Malady x 50, Drake's Blood x 3, Mushmom Spore x 1, Medicine With Weird Vibes x 25, Malady's Experimental Frog x 25

quests.description:
Jane says she will make me something even better.
For this last experiment, Jane promised to make me a mysterious scroll. For that, she needs 1 Moon Rock, 20 Dragon Skins, and 10 vials of Sap of Ancient Tree. Maybe I should ask the fairies in Ellinia for the Moon Rock...
I got the materials Jane needed and the scroll for gloves was made without a hitch. Sweet! Jane expressed a strong desire to keep experimenting. Maybe next time I return I'll be able to buy something from her that's not sold in stores...
quests.name: Jane's Final Challenge
quests.requirements: Defeat Dark Axe Stump x 100, Defeat Drake x 50, Moon Rock x 1, Dragon Skin x 20, Sap of Ancient Tree x 10
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Gloves Attack Scroll: Intermediate (25%), Gloves Attack Scroll: Greater (25%), Gloves Magic Attack Scroll: Intermediate (25%), Gloves Magic Attack Scroll: Greater (25%)

quests.description:
Let's go meet John in Lith Harbor.
I met a fisherman named John in Lith Harbor. He wants to get his wife a nice flower basket for their upcoming anniversary and asked if I could get him 10 Pink Violas for her. According to him, a Mysterious Statue can take me to the flower's location. Sleepywood... Sleepywood ! ! ! That's FAR!!!
I got John all 10 Pink Violas. With these, he can make a beautiful flower basket for his wife on their anniversary. As a sign of appreciation, John got me a whole bunch of screws that were left over from parts of a ship. By the way, if there are this many screws that had fallen out of that ship, then how in the world is it even still sailing... Is it still carrying passengers
quests.name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Pink Flower Basket

quests.description:
Let's go see John in Lith Harbor again.
I ran into John the fisherman again in Lith Harbor. This time, he wants to get his wife Blue Violas for her birthday and asked me to get 20 Blue Violas for him. Apparently, the scent of Blue Violas lasts for over 500 years... John told me that they can be found in the same place as last time, the Mysterious Statue. Man... Do I HAVE to go in there AGAIN
I got John all 20 Blue Violas. They do have a nice scent, but 20 of them Makes my head spin... As a sign of appreciation, John gave me a nice glove he found inside the ship. I mean, it looks like someone accidentally left their glove there... Is he allowed to give it to me like that What if I wear it around town and run into its actual owner
quests.name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Present
quests.rewards_items: Work Gloves, Dark Knuckle, Dark Arten, Dark Brace, Dark Cleave

quests.description:
I hear John has one final thing to ask me...
I ran into John the fisherman again in Lith Harbor. This time, he told me his mother passed away recently, and he wants to get some White Violas for her. He asked me to get 30 White Violas for him. Apparently, the scent of White Violas lasts over 1,000 years... and, according to John, they can ALSO be found in the Mysterious Statue. Man... Do I HAVE to go in there AGAIN
I got John all 30 White Violas. They have a nice scent, but 30 of them Makes my head spin... As a sign of appreciation, John gave me a set of his mother's earrings. These earrings look like they are made of some common flowers, but it seems there's something more to them...
quests.name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Last Present

quests.description:
It looks like Olaf in Lith Harbor has prepared another round of training.
I saw Olaf again in Lith Harbor. He said my training is still far from over and gave me a mission to hunt stronger monsters, farther from town. Once I finish this training, will I finally become a true adventurer
I passed Olaf's second training with flying colors! Once I reach Level 10, I'll be all set to choose my job!
quests.name: Olaf's Second Training
quests.requirements: Defeat Pig x 8, Defeat Orange Mushroom x 8

quests.description:
I got the mirror from Sera, who was doing her laundry. I have to take it to Heena now.
I got the mirror from Sera, who was doing her laundry, and took it to Heena.
quests.name: Bringing a Mirror to Heena

quests.description:
It seems a sailor named Teo in Lith Harbor is looking for an adventurer to lend a hand.
Teo in Lith Harbor told me his hobby is collecting weird things. He asked me to hunt Slimes near the town and bring back 1 Slime Bubble. He warned me that it might be hard to find, though!
I delivered 1 Slime Bubble to Teo in Lith Harbor. But from the look on his face, he's already craving something else...
quests.name: Teo's Weird Hobby
quests.requirements: Defeat Slime x 10, Slime Bubble x 1

quests.description:
It seems like Teo in Lith Harbor still has more weird stuff he wants to collect.
Teo in Lith Harbor asked me for even weirder items to complete his collection. He said he absolutely NEEDS an intact Pig's Head... Why is he even collecting this kind of stuff
I delivered a Pig's Head to Teo in Lith Harbor. I guess I should keep his weird hobby a secret between us.
quests.name: Teo's Even Weirder Hobby
quests.requirements: Defeat Pig x 10, Pig's Head x 1

quests.description:
Talk to Roger.
Press the hotkey I to open your inventory, navigate to the Use tab, and double-click Roger's Apple to consume it. Then, talk to Roger.
You learned how to use items! This will make life much easier!
quests.name: Roger's Apple

quests.description:
Talk to Nina.
Nina is wondering what to make her brother, Sen, for dinner. Go talk to Sen, who's in the house next to Nina, and ask him what he wants to eat.
You asked Sen, Nina's brother, what he wants for dinner. He said he wants Mushroom Soup.
quests.name: What Sen wants to eat

quests.description:
Sen wants Mushroom Soup for dinner. Better tell Nina now.
You told Nina what Sen wants for dinner.
quests.name: Returning to Nina

quests.description:
You hear that Todd can teach you how to hunt...
Todd asked me to defeat Tutorial Jr. Sentinels, then talk to Peter.
You defeated the monsters, just as Todd instructed.
quests.name: Todd's How-to-Hunt
quests.requirements: Defeat Tutorial Jr. Sentinel x 3, Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece x 3

quests.description:
Sam has some advice for beginner adventurers...
Sam told me to head east and hunt 10 Snails before meeting up with Mai.
As Sam suggested, you hunted 10 Snails, then met Mai. Is this person a master They definitely give off a strong, powerful vibe.
quests.name: Sam's Suggestion

quests.description:
Maria needs someone to help her...
Maria needs help. She asked me to deliver a letter to Lucas in Amherst.
I delivered Maria's Letter to Lucas in Amherst.
quests.name: Letter for Lucas
quests.parent: Please bring this letter to Lucas

quests.description:
I delivered Maria's Letter to Lucas in Amherst, and he wrote her a reply. I should bring it back to Maria now.
Maria looked relieved after reading the reply from Lucas. Now I want to read it too. Wonder what this was all about...
quests.name: Lucas's Reply
quests.parent: Please bring this letter to Lucas
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Brown Skullcap (14.29%), Green Skullcap (14.29%), Red Headband (14.29%), Black Headband (14.29%), Green Headband (14.29%), Yellow Headband (14.29%), Blue Headband (14.29%)

quests.description:
Mai at A Split Road seems like a martial arts specialist who can train beginners.
I am now under the tutelage of the famous sword master, Mai, in A Split Road. For my first lesson, she told me to hunt Blue Snails, Shrooms, and Red Snails. Ah, Mai also said to meet up with Biggs in Southperry for a useful quest.
Mai trained you, and you feel stronger.
quests.name: Mai's Training
quests.requirements: Defeat Blue Snail x 10, Defeat Shroom x 10, Defeat Red Snail x 5

quests.description:
Mai's training is just about defeating monsters, but it seems really useful for learning how to hunt. Let's continue with Mai's training.
Mai believes that, while understanding my abilities is important, challenging myself with stronger monsters is also a great training method. She asked me to defeat 1 Orange Mushroom. An Orange Mushroom... They seem really strong. Can I really defeat one
After Mai's training, I feel much, much stronger. Time to get off Maple Island! I should go to Southperry and take the boat to Victoria Island.
quests.name: Mai's Final Training

quests.description:
I hear that Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys is worried about something...
I ran into Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys, who seemed overcome with worry. She told me that they were short on decorations for the village festival and asked me to get 10 Slime Bubbles and 20 Pig's Ribbons.
I brought back all the stuff Mrs. Ming Ming asked me for, but I'm sure these decorations are not the only things needed for the festival...
quests.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's First Worry
quests.requirements: Slime Bubble x 10, Pig's Ribbon x 20

quests.description:
I hear Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys has a new concern...
I saw Mrs. Ming Ming again in Henesys; she's still preparing for the village carnival. She said that this time she needs food for the carnival and asked me to collect 10 Pig's Heads, 30 Octopus Legs, and Estelle's Special Sauce. To get the Special Sauce, I think I'll have to go find Estelle in The Field South of Ellinia.
I met up with Estelle in The Field South of Ellinia to get her Estelle's Special Sauce, but she apparently doesn't want to give it to me for free...
quests.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Second Worry

quests.description:
Estelle in The Field South of Ellinia wants a Garnet in exchange for her Special Sauce. She wants to buy a necklace for her mom's birthday gift.
I got 1 Garnet for Estelle, who I met near The Hill East of Henesys, for making her mother's birthday present. She gave me Estelle's Special Sauce. I better collect the other materials and return to Mrs. Ming Ming.
quests.name: Estelle's Request

quests.description:
I got the Special Sauce from Estelle in The Field South of Ellinia. Now, I need to deliver it to Mrs. Ming Ming, along with 10 Pig's Heads and 30 Octopus Legs.
I got all the materials that Mrs. Ming Ming asked me to get and gave them to her. I can't wait to see the village carnival!
quests.name: Estelle's Special Sauce
quests.requirements: Pig's Head x 10, Octopus Leg x 30, Estelle's Special Sauce x 1

quests.description:
Find Pia in Henesys Park.
Under the watchtower in Henesys Park, I saw Pia, who was wearing a teddy bear costume. How cute! She told me that she ran into a bully Blue Mushroom on her way to Ellinia, and now she wants me to show the rude mushroom who's boss! I need to collect 20 Green Mushroom Caps and 20 Blue Mushroom Caps to show her as evidence. I contemplated telling Pia she's basically asking to be teased, wandering around the forest in a teddy bear costume like that, but I decided against it.
I delivered 20 Green Mushroom Caps and 20 Blue Mushroom Caps to Pia in Henesys Park. She was thrilled that she got vengeance on the mushrooms and gave me a scroll for hat. All I have to do is click on it in the Use tab of my Item Inventory and drag it to my helmet in the Equipment window... Oh, and I'll have to cross my fingers and hope the scroll doesn't fail.
quests.name: Pia and the Blue Mushroom
quests.requirements: Green Mushroom Cap x 20, Blue Mushroom Cap x 20
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Hat Accuracy Scroll: Lesser (33.33%), Hat Accuracy Scroll: Intermediate (33.33%), Hat Accuracy Scroll: Greater (33.33%)

quests.description:
I hear that Camila in Henesys is worried about something...
I met Camila in Henesys, and, because of her timid disposition, she needs me to deliver Sparkling Glass Marble to Utah for her. I can get to Utah's Pig Farm through The Forest East of Henesys...
I delivered a gift from Camila to Utah. I'm sure they're really close friends, since they're giving each other what's most precious to themselves. I wish I could meet a friend like that during my journey...
quests.name: Camila's Gem
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: 30x Cake (70%), Pig Illustrated (30%)

quests.description:
I hear that Maya in Henesys is very sick...
A girl named Maya in Henesys Townstreet has been ill for a long time. It seems like she hasn't been able to live a normal life at all, so I agreed to do what I could to help. Weird Medicine... What a strange name! She told me that it helps improve her health, at least a little bit... I should go to Lith Harbor and see this guy, Teo.
Maya wanted me to go see Teo of Lith Harbor, so I did just that. He promised to give me the Weird Medicine, but only after I get him a Sparkling Rock. Geez, he won't even give any free medicine for a sick girl
quests.name: Maya of Henesys

quests.description:
In Lith Harbor, I met a heavily bearded crew member named Teo. He does have the Weird Medicine, but explained that, in order for it to work properly, it needs a Sparkling Rock. He told me that he'll hand the medicine over if I can bring one to him. To get the Sparkling Rock, I need to head to Perion Department Store and speak with Sophia, the daughter of the store's owner.
I met Sophia. To make the Sparkling Rock, she said she needs Arcon's Blood.
quests.name: Finding Sophia

quests.description:
I met Sophia in Perion Department Store. She told me that she's working on her dream of becoming an alchemist. To make the Sparkling Rock, she says she needs 30 Squishy Liquids, 30 Leafs, 30 Octopus Legs, and 1 Arcon's Blood. Everything looks reasonable enough... wait, Arcon's Blood ! Fortunately, Sophia knew where to get some. She told me to have a chat with Manji, who should be somewhere around Perion.
Sophia told me that Manji has some Arcon's Blood, a key ingredient in making a Sparkling Rock.
quests.name: Making a Sparkling Rock

quests.description:
I found Manji in Perion, and as expected, he was unwilling to give me any Arcon's Blood for free. He told me to go to the underground tunnel in the middle of the island, defeat 75 Zombie Mushrooms, and gather up 40 Charm of the Undead. I practically shivered from Manji's icy demeanor... In that moment, I almost regretted agreeing to help Maya, but no one else had seemed willing to...
Manji asked me to defeat Zombie Mushrooms and gather Charm of the Undead in return for Arcon's Blood.
quests.name: Arcon's Blood?
quests.requirements: Defeat Zombie Mushroom x 75, Charm of the Undead x 40

quests.description:
Biggs in Southperry has a task for you.
I met Biggs in Southperry. He wants me to get him 1 Orange Mushroom Cap and 10 Blue Snail Shells. He seemed pretty skeptical that I'd be able to do it, but it sounds like a piece of cake to me!
I gathered 1 Orange Mushroom Cap and 10 Blue Snail Shells for Biggs in Southperry. The weapon he gave me as a reward was pretty decent.
quests.name: Biggs's Collection of Items
quests.requirements: Blue Snail Shell x 10, Orange Mushroom Cap x 1
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Fruit Knife (50%), Razor (50%)

quests.description:
I gathered up 40 Charm of the Undead from the Ant Tunnel and gave them to Manji of Perion. Still cocky, still arrogant, but following through on his promise, he handed over Arcon's Blood. Maybe he isn't the WORST. Next, I need to gather up 30 Squishy Liquids, 30 Leafs, 30 Octopus Legs, and the Arcon's Blood for Sophia.
I brought the Charm of the Undead to Manji and finally got Arcon's Blood. I should hurry back to Sophia...
quests.name: Getting Arcon's Blood
quests.requirements: Squishy Liquid x 30, Arcon's Blood x 1, Leaf x 30, Octopus Leg x 30

quests.description:
Sophia looked genuinely surprised when I handed her all the materials she needed to make the Sparkling Rock. Well, it wasn't easy! Anyway, she made a Sparkling Rock with the materials I gathered and gave it to me. The Sparkling Rock... gives off this strange light and... the way it glitters... I can understand why someone would want one of these! It's mesmerizing! Well, now I just have to trade it with Teo in Lith Harbor.
Sophia was startled when she saw I had gotten Arcon's Blood, and she made me a Sparkling Rock with it. Now then, should I go back to Teo in Lith Harbor
quests.name: Making Sparkling Rock

quests.description:
I gave the Sparkling Rock to Teo in Lith Harbor and received Weird Medicine in return. Now, all I need to do is get this to Maya, and I'll finally be done. The deeper I get into this, the more I regret saying yes. Anyway, this medicine looks quite tasty. If I ever find myself thirsty and without any water, maybe I should just drink it myself. Hahaha...
I went back to Henesys and handed Maya the Weird Medicine. Hopefully it'll help her get better. As a sign of thanks, Maya gave me some Mesos and a Brown Bamboo Hat. The hat... I mean, it looked like it'd protect me from the sun, but it was so old and raggedy... And when I put it on, it made this weird noise... It felt like insects were moving around inside it... Am I going to be okay
quests.name: Delivering the Weird Medicine

quests.description:
Let's meet Luke the Security Guy at the Henesys Dungeon Entrance.
At the Dungeon Entrance, I met Luke, the guard. He told me that he wanted to make a nourishing snack for his mother and asked me to hunt 20 Jr. Neckis and 20 Stirges and bring back 10 Jr. Necki Skins, 10 Stirge Wings, and 1 Salad. He said he's too busy with his guard duties to do it himself... but, honestly, he looks like he's sleeping on the job!!
I got Luke, who protects the entrance of the dungeon, the stuff he asked for. Since he was already making the Snake Drink and all... I wanted a taste for myself! In return, Luke gave me a nicely refined jewel he found around the area. It's not like refined jewels fall from the sky... Did someone lose it while traveling Anyway, I should drop by later when the Snake Drink is ready...
quests.name: Luke the Security Guy
quests.requirements: Defeat Jr. Necki x 20, Defeat Stirge x 20, Salad x 1, Jr. Necki Skin x 10, Stirge Wing x 10
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Diamond (12.5%), Garnet (12.5%), Amethyst (12.5%), Aquamarine (12.5%), Emerald (12.5%), Opal (12.5%), Sapphire (12.5%), Topaz (12.5%)

quests.description:
I hear that Luke the Security Guy made up his mind about something...
I met with Luke at the entrance of the dungeon again. The Snake Drink from back then was completely gone... because he and his mom drank it all... Ah, well. Luke said he was over the boring life of a security guard and has decided to go on an adventure. To make a glove fit for the journey, Silas Irons of Perion is asking for 1 Black Feather, 10 Orihalcon Ingots, 30 Drake Skulls, 20 Dragon Skins, and 20 Screws! He wants me to gather them for him... The fairies of Ellinia might know something about the Black Feather.
I brought Luke the materials he needed to make the gloves and received his treasured heirloom helmet, Bronze Crusader Helm, in return. It felt like I got the short end of the deal... but since it's a family heirloom, passed down for generations, I couldn't really complain...
quests.name: Luke the Security Guy's Wish to Travel
quests.requirements: Black Feather x 1, Orihalcon Ingot x 10, Screw x 20, Drake Skull x 30, Dragon Skin x 20
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Bronze Crusader Helm (100%)

quests.description:
Go see Maya in Henesys.
I got a request from Maya of Henesys, who likes collecting all kinds of items. She wants 20 of each of the following: Orange Mushroom Cap, Green Mushroom Cap, Blue Mushroom Cap, and Horny Mushroom Cap. It looks like I can get all of these from hunting monsters around the prairie...
I got everything Maya asked for, but when do I get rewarded for this What How many more times do I have to do this
quests.name: Maya's First Collection
quests.requirements: Orange Mushroom Cap x 20, Green Mushroom Cap x 20, Blue Mushroom Cap x 20, Horny Mushroom Cap x 20

quests.description:
This time Maya wants 20 of each of the following: Pig's Ribbon, Bubbling's Huge Bubble, Fire Boar's Tooth, and Tablecloth. I can get those from hunting monsters around the plateau, subway station, and prairie... Well, at least it'll be easy!
I got everything Maya asked for. Please don't tell me she wanted all of it for free...
quests.name: Maya's Second Collection
quests.requirements: Pig's Ribbon x 20, Bubbling's Huge Bubble x 20, Fire Boar's Tooth x 20, Tablecloth x 20

quests.description:
Maya requested 30 of each of the following: Iron Hog's Metal Hoof, Lupin Doll, Cold Eye Tail, and Tortie Shell. I can get those from monsters in the highland, beach, and prairie. A little more of a challenge...
I got everything Maya asked for. I'm still not getting anything How many more times do I have to do this
quests.name: Maya's Third Collection
quests.requirements: Iron Hog's Metal Hoof x 30, Lupin Doll x 30, Cold Eye Tail x 30, Tortie Shell x 30

quests.description:
Go see Maya in Henesys.
Maya asked me to gather 1 Diamond, 50 Stone Golem Rubble, and 50 Dark Stone Golem Rubble. I can get them by defeating monsters at the Golem's Temple, which is on the way from Henesys to the dungeon... but this is getting way too hard!
I got all the items Maya requested for the last time... or is it As a sign of appreciation, she gave me a cape her grandma made for Athena Pierce, the chief of this town. It may be really old, but it still looks brand new!
quests.name: Maya's Last Collection
quests.requirements: Stone Golem Rubble x 50, Dark Stone Golem Rubble x 50, Diamond x 1

quests.description:
Let's go to Pia in Henesys.
I ran into that same teddy-bear-costume-wearing Pia at the Henesys Park. Last time I saw her, I took care of some Blue Mushrooms for her. This time, she wants to make a claw as a present for a friend in Ellinia, who's embarking on an adventure soon. The claw she wants to make requires 15 Silver Ingots, 30 Dragon Skins, and 30 Screws... If I get her all these... will I be richly rewarded
Pia asked me help her with a gift for her friend who decided to set out on an adventure. I brought back what she needed, but it seemed that wasn't enough.
quests.name: Pia's Present For a Friend
quests.requirements: Silver Ingot x 15, Dragon Skin x 30, Screw x 30

quests.description:
Pio in Amherst wants you to help collect recycled goods.
I ran into Pio, who's famous in Amherst for fixing broken things. He asked me to break down wooden boxes from around town and bring back Rusty Screws and Old Wooden Boards.
I broke wooden boxes and collected supplies for Pio. It was fun because I found other useful items in the boxes as well.
quests.name: Pio's Collecting Recycled Goods
quests.requirements: Rusty Screw x 3, Old Wooden Board x 3

quests.description:
Let's go to Pia in Henesys.
Pia also asked me to retrieve the Red Cape that Rina in Henesys borrowed, to give it to her friend too. She'll give me something nice if I bring it back to her.
I went to Rina to get Pia's cape, but Rina told me that she's keeping the cape until Pia brings back what she borrowed from her.
quests.name: Looking for the Red Cape

quests.description:
It seems Rina has her own reasons for not returning Pia's cape.
I went to see Rina in Henesys, and she told me she actually took that red cape because Pia also hasn't returned some items that she borrowed. She says that she'll return the cape when she gets her things back... The items are 1 Black Crystal, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 30 Medicine With Weird Vibes.
I paid off Pia's debt to Rina on her behalf and received the Red Cape in return. Next, all I have to do is bring this back to Pia.
quests.name: What Pia Borrowed
quests.requirements: Medicine With Weird Vibes x 30, Ancient Scroll x 1, Black Crystal x 1

quests.description:
It looks like Rina is ready to return the Red Cape she borrowed from Pia.
I finally got my hands on the Red Cape that Pia asked for. Now, I just need to bring it back to her.
I delivered the materials needed to make the claw to Pia in Henesys Park and received a scroll in return. I wonder if Pia's friend has already set out on their adventure by now. Who knows Maybe I'll run into them during my travels!
quests.name: Pia's Gift
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Cape STR Scroll: Greater (25%), Cape DEX Scroll: Greater (25%), Cape INT Scroll: Greater (25%), Cape LUK Scroll: Greater (25%)

quests.description:
I should go see Bruce in Henesys...
I met Bruce, who's been studying the monsters and animals around Henesys. His bright smile and easygoing demeanor belie the painful fact that his daughter has been missing for some time now. The reason he's been studying the mushroom monsters is to uncover clues as to his daughter's whereabouts. He asked if I could help him out, and I just couldn't say no to such a worthy cause...
I helped Bruce gather up the materials necessary for his studies. Will these help him find his daughter
quests.name: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies
quests.parent: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies
quests.requirements: Defeat Shroom x 20, Defeat Orange Mushroom x 20, Mushroom Spore x 10, Orange Mushroom Cap x 10
quests.rewards_items: 10x Red Potion, 2x Return Scroll to Henesys

quests.description:
I wonder how Bruce is doing in Henesys these days...
I met up with Bruce in Henesys, and he had great news; he finally found his daughter!! There's one problem, however... She is suffering from amnesia! Bruce gave me a toy that his daughter liked to play with growing up and asked me to deliver it to her.
I found Ayan and gave her Ayan's Toy Sword.
quests.name: I Need to Find My Daughter 1
quests.next_quest_name: I Need to Find My Daughter 2
quests.parent: I Need to Find My Daughter

quests.description:
It seems that Ayan, having regained her memories of the past, is eager to share the news with her father.
Amazingly, Ayan recovered from her amnesia with the help of her toy sword. It was amazing! The only thing left now is for Ayan and Bruce to finally reunite. But first, I have to get this letter from Ayan back to Bruce.
I was so glad that Ayan got her memory back. I was even gladder that Bruce finally got to see his daughter again! How touching...
quests.name: I Need to Find My Daughter 2
quests.parent: I Need to Find My Daughter

quests.description:
I'm not a beginner anymore. Talk to Rain in Amherst and take the Maple Quiz!
I'm not a total newbie anymore. Talk to Rain and take the Maple Quiz!
Rain's first question was about how to hang from a ladder or rope. All right! Up arrow key, make sure to remember it well.
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 1

quests.description:
Solve Rain's second question.
What's Rain's second question
Rain's question was about equippable items, which can be worn by double-clicking on them.
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 2

quests.description:
Rain's third question.
Time for Rain's third question.
In the Equipment Inventory, I can check the items I'm wearing, and I can also double-click to unequip them.
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 3

quests.description:
Time to answer Rain's fourth question.
I can answer Rain's questions if I think carefully enough.
Rain's fourth question was about ways to recover HP. I didn't know there were so many different methods! When I find a chair or bench, I should make sure to sit down.
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 4

quests.description:
Rain's fifth question. Wonder what it's about.
What's the fifth question
Rain asked about job advancements. Warriors, Thieves, Bowmen, and Magicians all need to be at least level 10 to advance.
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 5

quests.description:
Time to answer Rain's 6th question.
And next, the sixth question.
I learned that when I level up, I get AP. If I use the AP on the stats I want, I can make them stronger. I'll make sure to remember that.
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 6

quests.description:
This is Rain's last question. Excited
Finally, the last question. After this, I'll be a true Mapler.
Rain advised that it's time to leave Maple Island. In Victoria Island, I can choose a job and start a lot of new adventures. Head to Southperryto get to Victoria Island!
quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 7

quests.description:
Arwen the Fairy from Ellinia has lost something...
Arwen the Fairy from Ellinia told me that she lost Arwen's Glass Shoe a couple of days ago, on her way to Perion. A monster covered in flames stole it! Fairies tend to obsess over glimmering, shiny objects, so she obviously wants it back... Time to go hunt some boars near Perion.
I returned Arwen's Glass Shoe to Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia. I got lucky, finding it off a nasty Fire Boar. As a sign of gratitude, she gave me a fairy item. It's gorgeous and glimmers like a star. Maybe I can use this to make something special.
quests.name: Arwen and the Glass Shoe
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Piece of Ice (50%), Fairy Wing (50%)

quests.description:
I think Rowen the Fairy in Ellinia has something to ask me...
I ran into Rowen the Fairy again, who had given me Fresh Milk for Ronnie, Mr. Wetbottom's son, last time. Back then, she seemed guarded, but now, she's accepted me as Ronnie's friend... Rowen the Fairy is an assistant for the head magician of Ellinia, Grendel the Really Old. She's concerned about the Cursed Dolls: evil dolls he'd made with black magic, a long, long time ago. While they'd been sealed for quite some time, a bunch of Lupins recently stole them and got away. The Lupins have since become zombies and are destroying the forest. To take back the forest, someone needs to eliminate the Zombie Lupins and take the Cursed Dolls away from them... So, I readily accepted the request to collect 50 Cursed Dolls, but I fear those crazy monkeys may be too much to handle...
I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all 50 Cursed Dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me 7 ores. I hope the forest returns to normal...
quests.name: Collecting 50 Cursed Dolls
quests.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
quests.requirements: Defeat Zombie Lupin x 50, Cursed Doll x 50

quests.description:
70 Well, that shouldn't be too hard...
I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in the forest near Ellinia and collected all 70 Cursed Dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me 10 ores. I hope the forest returns to normal soon...
quests.name: Collecting 70 Cursed Dolls

quests.description:
Rowen the Fairy asked for my help again, this time to hunt 100 Zombie Lupins and collect 100 Cursed Dolls. It's getting quite serious now...
I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all 100 Cursed Dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me 5 very rare ores. I hope the forest returns to normal soon...

quests.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
quests.requirements: Defeat Zombie Lupin x 100, Cursed Doll x 100

quests.description:
Rowen the Fairy asked for my help again, this time to hunt 150 Zombie Lupins and collect 150 Cursed Dolls. Now that's a lot of Cursed Dolls!
I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all 150 Cursed Dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me a scroll for gloves. I hope the forest returns to normal soon...
quests.name: Collecting 150 Cursed Dolls
quests.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
quests.requirements: Defeat Zombie Lupin x 150, Cursed Doll x 150
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Gloves Attack Scroll: Intermediate (50%), Gloves Magic Attack Scroll: Intermediate (50%)

quests.description:
Rowen the Fairy asked for my help one last time, this time to hunt 200 Zombie Lupins and collect 200 Cursed Dolls. Does she really need THIS many Is it working
I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all 200 Cursed Dolls for Rowen the Fairy. In return, she gave me a nice hat. I collected so many dolls for her, but it seemed like the Zombie Lupins aren't decreasing in any way, shape, or form... I wonder what was going on. However, it seemed that the fairies might not have as much animosity toward humans now... That's a good thing, at least.
quests.name: Collecting 200 Cursed Dolls
quests.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll

quests.description:
Let's go meet Ronnie in the woods in Ellinia.
Ronnie from the forest of Ellinia asked me for help gathering materials to build a house for the newborn fairies that are to come down the road soon. I can collect 30 Horny Mushroom Caps and 30 Curse Eye Tails by hunting Horny Mushrooms and Curse Eyes...
I got all the items Ronnie requested, but when do I get rewarded for this What How many more times do I have to do this
quests.name: First Material Delivery for Building a New House
quests.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House
quests.requirements: Defeat Horny Mushroom x 50, Defeat Curse Eye x 50, Horny Mushroom Cap x 30, Curse Eye Tail x 30

quests.description:
Meet Ronnie in the Unknown Map(105010000).
Ronnie asked me to collect 30 Bubbling's Huge Bubbles and Tablecloths by taking down Bubblings and Jr. Wraiths. I should be able to get them from the monsters living in the Kerning City subway. That sounds like it'll be no problem!
I got everything for Ronnie. Please don't tell me he wanted all these for free...!
quests.name: Second Material Delivery for Building a New House
quests.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House
quests.requirements: Defeat Bubbling x 50, Defeat Jr. Wraith x 50, Bubbling's Huge Bubble x 30, Tablecloth x 30

quests.description:
Meet Ronnie in the Unknown Map(105010000).
Ronnie asked me to hunt Fire Boars and Copper Drakes and collect 30 Fire Boar's Tooth and 30 Drake Skull. I should be able to get them from the monsters around Perion. Things are starting to get a bit tricky...
I got everything for Ronnie. I still didn't get anything How many more times do I have to do this
quests.name: Third Material Delivery for Building a New House
quests.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House
quests.requirements: Defeat Fire Boar x 50, Defeat Copper Drake x 50, Fire Boar's Tooth x 30, Drake Skull x 30

quests.description:
Meet Ronnie in the Unknown Map(105010000).
Ronnie asked me for help one last time. This time, he wants me to get 30 Cold Eye Tails, 10 Dragon Skins, and 1 Diamond by taking down Cold Eyes and Drakes. I guess I can do it, but hunting down in the deep parts of the Ant Tunnel... This is way too hard!!
I got all the materials Ronnie needed for the last time. Is this it For the reward, he gave me a scroll for shoes he got as a gift from the fairies, who found it somewhere around the forest. He couldn't figure out how to use the scroll, so I'm getting it... hopefully it works... haha...
quests.name: Last Material Delivery for Building a New House
quests.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House
quests.requirements: Defeat Cold Eye x 50, Defeat Drake x 50, Cold Eye Tail x 30, Dragon Skin x 10, Diamond x 1
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Shoes Speed Scroll: Intermediate (50%), Shoes Speed Scroll: Greater (50%)

quests.description:
Whenever I walk past Wing the Fairy in Ellinia, he seems to be asking for help. I wonder why...
Wing the Fairy of Ellinia seems to have a general disdain for humans. Definitely not the kind of attitude I'd expect from someone asking for a FAVOR. Well, he asked me to get him 10 Leafs, 10 Squishy Liquids, and 3 Slime Bubbles. They're ingredients for a potion he was assigned to make for homework.
I helped Wing the Fairy of Ellinia with his homework. I have no idea what that potion is for, though.
quests.name: I Need Help on My Homework!
quests.parent: I Need Help on My Homework!
quests.requirements: Leaf x 10, Squishy Liquid x 10, Slime Bubble x 3
quests.rewards_items: 10x Blue Potion, 2x Return Scroll to Ellinia

quests.description:
It looks like Shane in Ellinia is looking for an adventurer to lend a hand.
Shane in Ellinia wants to eat a delicious mushroom dish and asked me to find some ingredients for him. He said that Green Mushroom Caps are a favorite of his, so I should head out and hunt Green Mushrooms near the forest.
I gave Green Mushroom Caps to Shane in Ellinia. Can he really make a delicious meal out of this
quests.name: How to Enjoy Mushrooms
quests.requirements: Defeat Green Mushroom x 30, Green Mushroom Cap x 15

quests.description:
It looks like Shane in Ellinia has another favor to ask.
Shane in Ellinia said he learned of an even better way to cook Green Mushroom Caps and asked me to bring some Green Mushroom Caps, as well as a Lemon.
I delivered the Green Mushroom Caps and Lemon to Shane in Ellinia. It feels like the dish might actually taste better than the last one, doesn't it
quests.name: How to Enjoy Mushrooms Even More
quests.requirements: Defeat Green Mushroom x 30, Green Mushroom Cap x 15, Lemon x 1

quests.description:
There is a runaway kid named Alex in Kerning City...
On a lonely building rooftop in Kerning City, I met a boy named Alex, who's run away from home because of a fight with his father, Chief Stan, in Henesys. But Alex is exhausted from being on the run and is out of money. He wants to go home and try to work things out with his strict, but admittedly loving, father. He asked me if I could persuade his father to not punish him for what he did. Also, he wants me to bring the Old Gold Watch his mother left him when she died, as proof that he really did have his father's forgiveness.
As Alex requested, I looked for his father in Henesys to get Alex's mother's Old Gold Watch.
quests.name: Alex's Request

quests.description:
At the entrance of Henesys, I met Alex's father, Chief Stan, the chief of Henesys. He wouldn't let me even start a conversation about Alex with him, and he demanded I bring him 15 Green Mushroom Caps and 15 Blue Mushroom Caps if I want to talk to him.
Only after I brought the Green Mushroom Caps and Blue Mushroom Caps did Chief Stan start talking to me.
quests.name: Talking to Stan
quests.requirements: Defeat Green Mushroom x 25, Defeat Blue Mushroom x 25, Green Mushroom Cap x 15, Blue Mushroom Cap x 15

quests.description:
At the entrance of Henesys, I met Alex's father Chief Stan, the chief of Henesys. He was even more ornery and difficult to talk to than I'd anticipated, but I finally convinced him to accept Alex back home with open arms. I also got Alex's late mother's Old Gold Watch as proof. Now, all I need to do is deliver this watch to Alex in Kerning City.
I gave Alex his late mother's Old Gold Watch. As a sign of appreciation, he gave me an earring he received from friends he met while traveling. Well, Chief Stan forgave Alex, but it doesn't seem like Alex plans to head home right away. Maybe I should keep an eye open next time I'm in Henesys.
quests.name: Mother's Gold Watch
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Weighted Earrings (50%), Yellow Square (50%)

quests.description:
I hear that Nella at Kerning City is the one to talk to if I'm looking for work...
I paid Nella a commission of 1,000 mesos in exchange for her bringing me various jobs and requests from the citizens of Kerning City. The first request is from Don Hwang, the owner of the armor shop, who needs materials for crafting new armor. I need to defeat 20 Orange Mushrooms and 20 Ribbon Pigs, and collect 10 Orange Mushroom Caps and 10 Pig's Ribbons. It shouldn't be too hard, since Orange Mushrooms and Ribbon Pigs are easy to find near Kerning City.
I delivered what Don Hwang asked for and got a bunch of Lemons in return. I wonder what kind of armor Don Hwang will make. Nella said there are many more requests I can fulfill. I should visit Nella every once in a while.
quests.name: Don Hwang's Request
quests.requirements: Defeat Orange Mushroom x 20, Defeat Ribbon Pig x 20, Orange Mushroom Cap x 10, Pig's Ribbon x 10
quests.rewards_items: 15x Lemon, 2x Return Scroll to Kerning City

quests.description:
I got a second request from Nella. Shumi, who usually hangs out in front of the subway, wants to build a house for the puppy she just got from a friend. I need to defeat 25 Dark Stumps and bring 15 Leafs to Nella for the dog house.
I delivered what Shumi asked for and got a bunch of Cakes in return. Now, Shumi's little puppy has his own house. Return to Nella for another gig.
quests.name: Shumi's Request
quests.requirements: Defeat Dark Stump x 25, Leaf x 15

quests.description:
I got a third request from Nella. Andre, an assistant at the Kerning City Hair Salon, is a lifelong bachelor and is apparently struggling with improving his cooking skills. He wants to try his hand at making some tasty seafood soup. I'll need to defeat 30 Octopus and collect 20 Octopus Legs, and also get 1 Pure Water. Once I've gathered everything, I need to deliver them to Nella.
I delivered what Andre asked for and got a glove in return. I hope he enjoys his hearty bowl of Seafood Soup. Return to Nella for another gig.
quests.name: Andre's Request
quests.requirements: Defeat Octopus x 30, Octopus Leg x 20, Pure Water x 1

quests.description:
Nella thinks I've grown a lot since my last visit; she's going to start giving me tasks of a slightly higher difficulty from here on out. First, she told me that Dr. Faymus, the owner of Kerning City Pharmacy, was working on a new potion when he ran out of ingredients. He needs me to hunt 40 Jr. Neckis and 40 Horny Mushrooms, and collect 20 Jr. Necki Skins and 20 Horny Mushroom Caps. Taking on Jr. Neckis could be a bit tricky, but for me, it shouldn't be too much trouble!
I delivered what Dr. Faymus asked for and got a bunch of White Potions in return. I wonder what kind of potion Dr. Faymus will make using those materials. Return to Nella for another gig.
quests.name: Dr. Faymus's Request
quests.parent: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Other Request
quests.requirements: Defeat Jr. Necki x 40, Defeat Horny Mushroom x 40, Jr. Necki Skin x 20, Horny Mushroom Cap x 20

quests.description:
I got another request from Nella. Chris's pillow was stolen a few days ago, and now he just can't get to sleep. To make a new pillow, he needs 20 Stiff Feathers and 20 pieces of Leather. I should get them as soon as possible, so Chris can get some sleep!
I delivered what Chris asked for and got some refined iron and bronze in return. Chris can finally sleep well with his new pillow. Return to Nella for another gig.
quests.name: Chris's Request
quests.parent: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Other Request

quests.description:
I got another request from Nella. Cutthroat Manny, the owner of the weapon shop, is quite the unusual foodie--he wants to cook up a special dish of Evil Eye Tail Stew. He needs me to hunt 50 Evil Eyes and bring back 30 Evil Eye Tails. Sounds like he'll be eating well for a while! Once I've gotten everything, I should bring it all back to Nella.
I delivered what Cutthroat Manny asked for and got a pair of shoes in return. Now... Cutthroat Manny doesn't have to worry about his dinner menu for a while. After helping out the people in this town, I feel like I've really become close with them!
quests.name: Cutthroat Manny's Request
quests.parent: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Other Request
quests.requirements: Defeat Evil Eye x 50, Evil Eye Tail x 30
quests.rewards_items: Red Whitebottom Boots, Mithril War Boots, Silver Wind Shoes, Brown Jack Boots, Blue Lappy Boots

quests.description:
I hear someone's been seen inside the Niora Hospital in Kerning City...
I met Jane Doe inside the Niora Hospital in Kerning City. Jane Doe needs to take off her bandages to see the results of her surgery, but there's no mirror in the nearly abandoned building. Jane Doe asked me to defeat 40 Stirges and collect 20 Broken Mirror Glasss, so she could take a look at herself...
I actually collected Broken Mirror Glass for the stranger I met in the Niora Hospital and brought it back to her.
quests.name: Stranger's Request
quests.requirements: Defeat Stirge x 40, Broken Mirror Glass x 20

quests.description:
The stranger I met in the Niora Hospital was, surprisingly, a ghost! She's been in the hospital all this time--unaware that she'd died, waiting for Dr. Niora to return... Now, unwilling to accept her death, she needs me to defeat 50 Zombie Mushrooms and collect 25 Charm of the Undead to bring her back to life. I really wonder if that's all it takes...
Jane Doe, whom I met in the Niora Hospital was a ghost. She was staying in the Hospital, not knowing that she was dead. She couldn't be revived with the Charm of the Undead. It seemed, deep down, that she already knew that, though... I really hope she finds peace.
quests.name: Stranger's Identity
quests.requirements: Defeat Zombie Mushroom x 50, Charm of the Undead x 25

quests.description:
It seems that Lakelis in Kerning City is looking for a party to take on a party quest that requires multiple adventurers to work together.
Lakelis in Kerning City asked me to challenge the party quest First Time Together and defeat King Slime inside. The party quest must be attempted by a party of four adventurers, all level 21 or higher. Once all members are ready, the party leader can speak to Lakelis to start the party quest. Better start looking for some friends to join me.
As requested by Lakelis, my friends and I challenged the party quest First Time Together and defeated King Slime. When everyone works together, there's nothing that can't be done!
quests.name: Proof of Companionship
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Earring STR Scroll: Intermediate (25%), Earring DEX Scroll: Intermediate (25%), Earring INT Scroll: Intermediate (25%), Earring LUK Scroll: Intermediate (25%)

quests.description:
Let's start looking for Shumi in Kerning City.
I met this girl named Shumi in Kerning City. She's devastated about losing the lucky coin that she borrowed from a friend, and she asked me to find it for her. She told me a bunch of guys draped in white cloths picked it up when she dropped it, and that I might find them at Construction Site B1, deep in the subway station... I guess I should head there first...
I found the lost coin that Shumi of Kerning City was looking for and returned it to her. A precious coin borrowed from her friend, huh... As a reward, she gave me a bunch of return scrolls... Not bad at all!! She also said other items can be found at Construction Site B1... I should check it out later...
quests.name: [Construction Site B1] Shumi's Lost Coin
quests.rewards_items: 5x Return Scroll - Nearest Town, 3x Return Scroll to Lith Harbor, 3x Return Scroll to Ellinia, 3x Return Scroll to Perion, 3x Return Scroll to Henesys, 3x Return Scroll to Kerning City, 3x Return Scroll to Sleepywood

quests.description:
Let's go look for Shumi in Kerning City.
I ran into Shumi again in Kerning City. She was really stressed out because she lost her rent money when a Stirge flew over and snatched it from her. Man... Do I have to go back down to the subway again... Can I just pay her rent for her at this point Anyway, I need to go back in there, this time to Construction Site B2, and find the roll of cash she lost. Aye, better get going...
I got Shumi from Kerning City the lost roll of cash. Guess she can pay her rent now... and as a reward, she gave me 30 Blue Potions... She also said I can find other items at Construction Site B2... I should go check it out sometime...
quests.name: [Construction Site B2] Shumi's Lost Roll of Cash

quests.description:
Let's go look for Shumi in Kerning City.
I ran into Shumi again at Kerning City. A while ago, she was doing a favor for JM From tha Streetz and getting some Screws for him. But the Sack of Cash he gave her to buy them fell out of her pocket while she was walking around in the subway, and she lost it. She said it fell deep into the subway station, to Construction Site B3.
I found Shumi's lost Sack of Cash in the Kerning City subway. Shumi can now buy what JM From tha Streetz asked for. I received Mesos and some potions as a gift. I should go to Construction Site B3 in the subway to look for more stuff.
quests.name: [Construction Site B3] Shumi's Lost Sack of Cash

quests.description:
I should go see Icarus, who's at the top of a building in Kerning City. He seems to be bored out of his mind.
I went to talk to Icarus in Kerning City. What exactly was he doing, staring aimlessly at the sky He seemed really bored and asked me if I'd answer his questions.
I answered all the questions that Icarus of Kerning City asked. That was easy.
quests.name: I'm Bored 1

quests.description:
I answered all the questions that Icarus of Kerning City asked. That was easy.
I answered all of Icarus's questions. But he still seemed bored out of his mind; he asked me if I'd bring him a toy to play with.
I had fun playing around with Icarus.
quests.name: I'm Bored 2
quests.requirements: Tree Branch x 12, Squishy Liquid x 12

quests.description:
Apparently, there's someone in Kerning City by the name of Icarus that stands on top of a building just staring at the sky, 24/7.
I went to meet Icarus on top of a building in Kerning City. He was a nice guy with an unquenchable thirst for flying. He's trying to fulfill his lifelong dream of flying by building a hang glider. He asked if I'd gather up the materials for it, and I couldn't reject his sincere desire to fly, even though this whole endeavor seems dubious at best. I'll need to get him 30 Stirge Wings, 10 Processed Woods, and 15 Stiff Feathers.
I got the materials Icarus needed to make the hang glider and realize his dream of flying. I just wonder if Stirge wings are enough to make the hang glider fly... I don't really know if this will work, but who knows, he could end up succeeding. I should check up on him when he's done building it.
quests.name: Icarus's Hang Glider
quests.requirements: Processed Wood x 10, Stirge Wing x 30, Stiff Feather x 15

quests.description:
I wonder how Icarus's doing with the hang glider... Maybe I should go check up on him in Kerning City.
Icarus failed to build a working hang glider, and, persistent in his never-ending quest for flight, is now attempting to create a flying balloon. This seems just as preposterous as his last idea, but I don't think I can stop him, so I might as well help him. To make the flying balloon, he needs 50 Tablecloths and 10 Alligator Skin Pouches. For his sake, I really hope this works...
I got the materials needed for Icarus to make a flying balloon and realize his dream of flying. I don't know if his 'flying balloon' will actually fly, but there's a chance that it might work. I'll check up on him around when the flying balloon should be ready to take flight and see if he's for real this time.
quests.name: Icarus and the Balloon
quests.requirements: Alligator Skin Pouch x 10, Tablecloth x 50

quests.description:
I wonder how Icarus's doing with the flying balloon... Maybe I should go check up on him in Kerning City.
Icarus's flying balloon didn't work out, but his quest for flight continues. This time, he wants to deviate from a scientific approach and opt for a magical one. He asked me to go see his best friend, Wing the Fairy, in Ellinia, the town of fairies. Apparently, Wing the Fairy knows how to make Flying Medicine... I'll need to go see him in Ellinia, for Icarus's sake.
Wing the Fairy in Ellinia dislikes humans so much that he wouldn't even listen to what I had to say.
quests.name: In search of Wing the Fairy
quests.next_quest_name: The Ingredients for the Flying Medicine

quests.description:
It doesn't seem easy to talk to Wing the Fairy.
I met Wing the Fairy in Ellinia, and he REALLY doesn't seem to like people. As a whole. How did he and Icarus become best friends in the first place Anyway, in order to make the Flying Medicine, he needs 50 Medicine With Weird Vibes and 20 Witchgrass Leafs. That's really all it takes to fly
As Wing the Fairy asked, I got him the Medicine With Weird Vibes and Witchgrass Leaf items. Can he make the Flying Medicine with these
quests.name: The Ingredients for the Flying Medicine
quests.requirements: Medicine With Weird Vibes x 50, Witchgrass Leaf x 20

quests.description:
It looks like the Flying Medicine that will finally fulfill Icarus's dream is finally ready.
Wing the Fairy of Ellinia asked me to deliver the Flying Medicine to Icarus. So this little bottle can make someone fly I need to get this to Icarus ASAP.
I got Icarus the Flying Medicine that Wing the Fairy of Ellinia made. I hope it works for him.
quests.name: Delivering the Flying Medicine
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Green Icarus Cape (33.33%), Yellow Icarus Cape (33.33%), Blue Icarus Cape (33.33%)

quests.description:
I hear that Blackbull in Perion is fixing up his house.
In the dusty town of Perion, I ran into a man named Blackbull. He needs to fix his house and asked if I could help him out by defeating 20 Stumps and 20 Dark Stumps and getting him 10 Tree Branches and 10 Leafs. If I do him a favor, I'll get a nice shield from him, but what if I say no I won't be... BANISHED from the village... will I I really hope not...
I got Blackbull of Perion 10 Tree Branches and 10 Leafs after defeating 20 Stumps and 20 Dark Stumps. With these, he can finally fix his house. I got this shield as a reward... and... well, there are scratch marks here and there, and it looks pretty old... Is this even usable
quests.name: Fixing Blackbull's House
quests.requirements: Defeat Stump x 20, Defeat Dark Stump x 20, Tree Branch x 10, Leaf x 10
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Wooden Buckler (90%), Steel Shield (10%)

quests.description:
I hear that Blackbull in Perion is building a new house...
I ran into Blackbull again, the guy whose house I'd helped fix before. He was surprised at how strong I'd gotten and asked me for another favor, a bit harder than the last one. His cousins from Henesys are trying to move to Perion, so he needs to build a new house for them! The materials he needs for this project are 100 Stone Golem Rubbles, 30 Screws, 30 Processed Wood, and Blackbull's Deed to the Land. His son had the deed when it was stolen by Curse Eyes near Sleepywood... Hmmm... I should look for ones wandering around in the Deep Forest...
I got Blackbull the items he requested, so that all of his cousins could move to Perion. It was really tough, and I hope he doesn't ask me to BUILD a house for him next time...
quests.name: Building a New House For Blackbull
quests.requirements: Stone Golem Rubble x 100, Screw x 30, Processed Wood x 30, Blackbull's Deed to the Land x 1

quests.description:
Find Manji in Perion.
I visited Manji again, whom I'd first met in Perion, when making the medicine for Maya of Henesys. Surprised at how much stronger I've become, Manji asked me for a favor. Long ago, when he was in danger of being struck down by Balrog, he was saved by the legendary hero Tristan, who ended up dying in Manji's place. Ever since then, Manji has held onto Tristan's sword. However, the blade was so corrupted by Balrog that it's almost too worn down to even be called a sword anymore... Manji handed me the Old Gladius that he'd held onto all these years and asked me to reawaken its true form. Once fully awakened, it will become the Hero's Gladius. Manji told me to begin with seeking out Chrishrama in Sleepywood.
I met Chrishrama in Sleepywood and was able to ask him how to awaken the Old Gladius.
quests.name: Old Gladius

quests.description:
See Chrishrama in Sleepywood to awaken the Old Gladius.
I showed Chrishrama Manji's Old Gladius, and he revealed that he was the sword's creator. He needs 1 Star Rock, 1 Piece of Ice, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 1 Flaming Feather to awaken it. Unfortunately, I've never heard of any of those items... He recommended talking to Mike in Perion Dungeon Entrance to get started.
I gathered the materials needed for the awakening and took them to Chrishrama. Chrishrama used the materials to reawaken the Old Gladius into the Hero's Gladius. It's a nice sword that radiates a mysterious light... It's a shame I have to give it to Manji.
quests.name: Reawakening the Gladius
quests.requirements: Star Rock x 1, Piece of Ice x 1, Ancient Scroll x 1, Flaming Feather x 1

quests.description:
After much hardship, I finally managed to gather all the materials Chrishrama asked for. Now, I can only trust in his power.
With Chrishrama's help, I awakened the Old Gladius, entrusted to me by Manji, into the Hero's Gladius. All that remains now is to return the sword to Manji.
It seems that this Hero's Gladius, which Manji told me about, is one fine sword. I had to make a hard decision choosing between the Hero's Gladius and the Skull Earrings that Manji offered me, but I don't regret my choice.
quests.name: Hero's Gladius
quests.rewards_items:
Pick one:
Any Class: Hero's Gladius, Skull Earrings

quests.description:
I hear that Winston the archeologist is searching for something in the Rocky Mountains on the east side of Perion...
Winston, an archaeologist I ran into in the Rocky Mountains east of Perion, has lost the fossils he's meticulously been collecting in the region. He asked me to bring back 12 Animal Fossils and 12 Plant Fossils, which have been stolen by Green Mushrooms and Axe Stumps. How could he lose such important things He's more careless than he looks...
I found the fossils that Winston lost.
quests.name: Searching for Fossils
quests.requirements: Defeat Green Mushroom x 25, Defeat Axe Stump x 25, Plant Fossil x 12, Animal Fossil x 12

quests.description:
It seems the archaeologist Winston in the Rocky Mountains, east of Perion, has another request.
Winston the archaeologist has realized that it's not the best idea to leave such valuable fossils in a tent. He asked me to deliver them to Dr. Betty in Ellinia for safekeeping. He also wrote me a letter of introduction to show her.
Winston the archeologist in Perion said that it is not safe to leave the valuable fossils in his tent. He asked me to deliver them to Dr. Betty in Ellinia. Dr. Betty said she's going to be really busy from now, and she asked me to stop by again and give her a hand afterwards. Fossils, huh... Should I give it a try
quests.name: Delivering a Box of Fossils
quests.requirements: Winston's Recommendation x 1, Fossil Box x 1

quests.description:
Dr. Betty, a biologist near Ellinia, is looking for an assistant.
Dr. Betty asked me to help out as her assistant for a bit. My first task is to collect 20 Plant Samples. I can see a lot of plants covering the woods in Ellinia.
My first job as Dr. Betty's assistant was to collect some plants in the woods in Ellinia and sample them. It wasn't that hard, I guess.
quests.name: Research on Plant Fossils

quests.description:
It seems the biologist, Dr. Betty, in Ellinia has another request.
Dr. Betty in Ellinia needs 1 Stuffed Drake Skull for her research. She asked me to fetch one from her daughter, who should be near Henesys. But where exactly would Anne be...
I met Dr. Betty's daughter, Anne, playing by herself near Henesys.
quests.name: Research on Animal Fossils

quests.description:
It looks like Anne has the item that Dr. Betty needs.
I got the Stuffed Drake Skull from Anne, Dr. Betty's daughter. Now, to deliver this VERY CAREFULLY to Dr. Betty...
I collected some Plant Samples and a Stuffed Drake Skull to help Dr. Betty's research on fossils. I can't wait to see the results... I should go and see Dr. Betty, because she said she would tell me when I go back.
quests.name: Transporting Drake's Skull

quests.description:
I hear Dr. Betty has finished her fossil research. Maybe I should go and see the results.
I visited Dr. Betty again. She finally completed her research and asked if I could take the final report to Dr. Winston in Perion. Dr. Betty also informed me that if I were to take 20 Leafs, 15 pieces of Firewood, 1 Stump's Teardrop, and 1 pair of Weighted Earrings, it'd make Dr. Winston very happy.
I delivered Dr. Betty's Fossil Report to Dr. Winston in Perion. Along with the report, I also gave him the Leaf, Firewood, Stump's Teardrop, and Weighted Earrings. In return, Dr. Winston gave me the Leaf Earrings.
quests.name: Progress on Fossil Research
quests.requirements: Leaf x 20, Firewood x 15, Fossil Report x 1, Stump's Teardrop x 1, Weighted Earrings x 1

quests.description:
Ayan of Perion says she can't take one step out of town. I wonder why...
I met Ayan in Perion. She can't remember anything about her childhood and lives every day in fear of the Stumps that surround Perion. She finds even looking at them too scary. Due to this paralyzing fear of Stumps, Ayan can't take a single step out of Perion, so she asked me to help her by thinning their numbers. Are they really THAT scary
I took out Stumps for Ayan's sake in Perion. She can finally venture outside without having to worry about them!
quests.name: The Stump Horror Story

quests.description:
I hear something happened to the tribespeople of Perion. I should go ask Ayan about this.
I spoke with Ayan in Perion. A few days ago, a group of tribespeople went hunting in the swamp and wound up being ambushed by a group of Ligators. She's worried about the sudden surge of Ligators, and other alligator monsters, taking over the swamp and asked me to reduce their numbers before they spawn out of control. I'll have to kill 100 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis and pick up 20 Jr. Necki Skins along the way.
The tribespeople of Perion got ambushed by the alligator herd at the swamp, so Ayan asked if I could help take care of the alligators. I responded by taking out 100 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis. Hopefully this will bring some peace back to the swamp.
quests.name: Taking Out the Alligators 1
quests.requirements: Defeat Jr. Necki x 40, Defeat Ligator x 100, Jr. Necki Skin x 20

Ayan of Perion is desperately looking for me. Is something wrong
I went to see Ayan, and she was in a panic. She had been walking around the swamp one day, when she ran into an even bigger, stronger, and more dangerous group of alligators, Crocos. She immediately turned and ran back to Perion. She'd been waiting for me to come by since then, hoping I could help her. This time, I'll need to kill 120 Crocos and bring back 50 Croco Skins.
At Ayan's request, I took out 120 Crocos in the swamp. I'll have to revisit that spot from time to time and take out the alligators so they don't spawn out of control.

quests.description:
I hear Mr. Wetbottom in Sleepywood is going through hard times... I should go check on him.
I met an old, balding man named Mr. Wetbottom in the VIP Sauna in Sleepywood. His son's run away from home with a book that's apparently more important to him than his own son He asked that I find his son, get the book, and bring JUST the book back. He offered me a nice sauna robe as a reward. Mr. Wetbottom told me that his son, Ronnie, likes to hang out at a tree tunnel somewhere around Ellinia. That's probably a good place to start searching. Seriously, though, just what is in this book of his...
I found Ronnie in the tree tunnel of Ellinia, as requested by Mr. Wetbottom, whom I met at the VIP Sauna.
quests.name: A Clue to the Secret Book

quests.description:
I found Mr. Wetbottom's son, Ronnie, inside a tree tunnel near Ellinia. He declared that he'd never hand over the red book, but he was also pretty hungry. Ronnie asked me to defeat Lupins in the western area of Ellinia and bring back 30 Lupin's Bananas.
I brought a bunch of Lupin's Bananas for the hungry Ronnie. But it looked like he still wanted to eat more...
quests.name: Hungry Ronnie
quests.requirements: Defeat Lupin x 50, Lupin's Banana x 30

quests.description:
Ronnie said that the Lupin's Bananas weren't enough for him and asked me to go see Rina at Henesys to get a plate of Rina's Unagi Special.
I went to see Rina of Henesys to help feed the hungry Ronnie.
quests.name: Still Hungry Ronnie

quests.description:
Rina of Henesys needs 50 Curse Eye Tails and 10 Pig's Heads as ingredients to make her unagi special.
I brought Rina everything needed to make Rina's Unagi Special.
quests.name: Secret to Unagi Special
quests.requirements: Curse Eye Tail x 50, Pig's Head x 10

quests.description:
I brought everything Rina asked for, and she whipped up a plate of Rina's Unagi Special for me. I hope Ronnie will finally be satisfied with this...
I brought Rina's Unagi Special to Ronnie. That kid sure seemed to enjoy it!
quests.name: Rina's Unagi Special

quests.description:
Ronnie got thirsty from eating Rina's Unagi Special. I need to go see Rowen the Fairy of Ellinia to get a glass of Fresh Milk for him.
I went to see Rowen the Fairy of Ellinia to help quench Ronnie's thirst.
quests.name: Thirsty Ronnie

quests.description:
Rowen the Fairy of Ellinia asked for a beautiful, glittering Diamond in exchange for a glass of Fresh Milk. A Diamond... And just how exactly am I supposed to get such a rare, expensive item
I brought a Diamond to Rowen the Fairy.
quests.name: Cold Milk

quests.description:
I brought Rowen the Fairy a Diamond in exchange for a glass of Fresh Milk. I hope Ronnie will FINALLY be satisfied with this...
I brought the Fresh Milk to Ronnie. Phew, I guess he's too full to eat any more now!
quests.name: Satisfied Ronnie

quests.description:
I got Ronnie all kinds of yummy snacks and finally got his dad's Secret Book in exchange. I really want to take just one peek...
I got Mr. Wetbottom the precious Secret Book that he'd been desperately looking for. I asked him if he's worried about Ronnie at all, only to hear that he'll be in good hands with the fairies... Well, it'd be best for Ronnie to stay with the fairies, right Anyway, I got the sauna clothes in return for the book... I guess wearing this cumbersome armor in the sauna is a ridiculous thing to do. Might as well enjoy it now and relax at the sauna...
quests.name: Returned Secret Book
quests.rewards_items: Blue Sauna Robe, Red Sauna Robe

quests.description:
Let's go look for Sabitrama in Sleepywood.
I met Sabitrama, a medicinal herb trader, in front of the Sleepywood Hotel. He appears to be the younger brother of Chrishrama. He recently discovered a place that grows the last herb he needs for a medicine he's been working on... He asked me to go deep in the forest and grab the Pink Anthurium. It's made of green grass and a small pink flower... I need to make sure I get him the same exact one. Shane from Ellinia can take me to the right place.
Thankfully, I got the flower that Sabitrama wanted from the Forest of Patience, and, as a sign of appreciation, he gave me a scroll for overall armor. Oh, and he also said that from here on out, I can enter the Forest of Patience without having to pay Shane of Ellinia. From what I've heard, the diet medicine Sabitrama's working on is for Shane's fiance... I should go back to the Forest of Patience when I have some spare time...
quests.name: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine
quests.parent: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Mysterious Medicine
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Overall Armor DEF Scroll: Intermediate (50%), Overall Armor DEF Scroll: Greater (50%)

quests.description:
I hear that Sabitrama in Sleepywood is making a new medicine...
I ran into Sabitrama in front of the Sleepywood Hotel again, the one I helped get herbs for before. This time, he found a new place with a different important herb that he needs for another type of medicine he's working on. He asked me to go back to the forest and grab a Double-Rooted Red Ginseng for him. It has a reddish root split in two... I should make sure I grab the same exact one once I get to the top. I guess that means I have to go back to Shane in Ellinia...
Thankfully, I got the herb that Sabitrama asked me to get, and for that, I was rewarded with a mysterious rock. And from here on out, I don't have to pay Shane every time I go in the Forest of Patience. From what I hear, that anti-aging medicine Sabitrama is working on may be what Shane needed... If I have time, I should go back in there...
quests.name: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine
quests.parent: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Mysterious Medicine

quests.description:
The cave fairy Zelya of the Forgotten Hollow seems to have a request. But even finding where the Forgotten Hollow is located may be a challenge in itself...
Zelya, a cave fairy in the Forgotten Hollow, told me about how her people once lived deep, deep inside the cave. She longs to return to her old home, but she was attacked by Glowshrooms while out on a walk and dropped the map she'd drawn to find her way back. The monsters may have already torn it to pieces, but if I defeat the Glowshrooms, east of Forgotten Hollow, and gather the fragments, she might be able to figure something out.
As the cave fairy Zelya requested, I defeated the monsters and brought back the fragments of the map of the route to her original home. Hopefully some clues can still be found within them...
quests.name: Zelya's Map

quests.description:
The cave fairy Zelya in the Forgotten Hollow seems to have a new request.
Zelya, a cave fairy in the Forgotten Hollow, has been struggling with piecing together the fragments of her map. She asked me to bring her Raffle Petals from Raffles east of the village to help in restoring it. Looks like that's where I'm headed, then!
As Zelya requested, I defeated Raffles and gathered enough Raffle Petals to bring back to her.
quests.name: Natural Adhesive
quests.requirements: Defeat Raffle x 50, Raffle Petal x 25

quests.description:
The cave fairy Zelya in Forgotten Hollow seems to have yet another request.
Zelya managed to restore her precious map and tried to follow it back to her old home, but she couldn't make it past the fierce monsters blocking the way. She asked me to defeat the monsters west of the Forgotten Hollow to help her get home safely.
As Zelya requested, I defeated Aqumanders and Echopuses. Yet it felt as though monsters continued to pour out from deeper within the cave. What on earth could be happening inside
quests.name: The Road Back Home
quests.requirements: Defeat Aqumander x 50, Defeat Echopus x 50
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Earring STR Scroll: Greater (25%), Earring DEX Scroll: Greater (25%), Earring INT Scroll: Greater (25%), Earring LUK Scroll: Greater (25%)

quests.description:
Myra in Perilous Descent I seems to be overcome with grief.
Myra in Perilous Descent I wants her changed companions to rest in peace. She asked me to put to rest the nearby Myewoods, as well as the Sporewoods deeper in the cave.
Following Myra's plea, I had no choice but to fell the creatures that were once her companions. How did they end up like this...
quests.name: Old Friends
quests.requirements: Defeat Myewood x 50, Defeat Sporewood x 30

quests.description:
Myra in Perilous Descent I seems to have another request.
Myra in Perilous Descent I asked me to tell her old friend, Grendel the Really Old, what had happened in the Forgotten Hollow. I should be able to find Grendel the Really Old atop Ellinia, in the Magic Library.
When I met Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia, he was astonished to hear that the Forgotten Hollow had been rediscovered, and he seemed deeply troubled about what was happening there.
quests.name: Myra's Old Friend

quests.description:
Let's go see Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia. He seems deeply troubled by something...
Grendel the Really Old, whom I met in Ellinia, asked me to gather 25 Luminous Magical Resonance vials from the Lupins. I should go to the forest and retrieve them so he can pinpoint the source of the magical disturbance.
I handed over the Luminous Magical Resonances and reported back to Grendel the Really Old! He confirmed that an ancient seal has fractured, and something buried long ago is waking up.
quests.name: The Roots of Regret

quests.description:
Grendel the Really Old confirmed that an ancient seal has broken, but he cannot pinpoint the exact location. He needs me to speak to Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia.
Grendel the Really Old asked me to speak with Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia. While he is human, the fairies are native to the forest and can naturally sense the distress of the ancient woods.
I approached Arwen the Fairy. She immediately smelled the dark magic clinging to me and demanded I stay back.
quests.name: A Fairy's Insight

quests.description:
The ambient dark energy is too overwhelming to track blindly. Arwen the Fairy asked me to hunt Cold Eyes in the forest and gather 25 Rotten Root Fragments to use as an alchemical tracking focus.
Arwen the Fairy agreed to help, but the ambient dark energy is too overwhelming to track blindly. She asked me to hunt Cold Eyes in the cursed forest and gather 25 Rotten Root Fragment to use as an alchemical tracking focus.
I brought the Rotten Root Fragments back to Arwen the Fairy. By using them as a tracking focus, she pinpointed a magical disturbance in the forest. She urged me to speak with her again immediately to help her trace the exact location.
quests.name: Tracing the Resonance
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Hat Accuracy Scroll: Intermediate (50%), Hat Accuracy Scroll: Greater (50%)

quests.description:
Arwen the Fairy successfully tracked the resonance toward the deep northern woods. She wants me to deliver this terrifying news to Grendel the Really Old.
I must speak with Grendel the Really Old. I need to tell him that Arwen the Fairy tracked the dark resonance directly to The Tree Tunnel At the Forest Up North.
I delivered Arwen's findings to Grendel the Really Old. Upon hearing the location, he realized an ancient barrier has been ripped open. The entrance to the Forgotten Hollow is revealed.
quests.name: The Yawning Abyss

quests.description:
Grendel the Really Old revealed that his kin were sealed away in the dark. There must be a place where the fairies still live within the Forgotten Hollow.
I must travel to The Tree Tunnel At the Forest Up North, find the newly opened abyss, and descend into the Forgotten Hollow to see what remains of the fairy homeland.
I descended into the Hollow and met an eccentric fairy named Nyroth, who chose to stay behind in the dark decades ago.
quests.name: Welcome to the Hollow
