quests.description:
Nyroth is trying to Arcforge a protection scroll using rot-steeped catalysts. Maybe he needs some help
I need to venture deeper into the dark tunnels, hunt the corrupted Rafflesias, and bring back 20 Rafflesia Petals for Nyroth's Arcforge.
I brought the petals to Nyroth, but the rot within them swallowed his forging fire. The failed synthesis produced a Scorched Arcon Scroll.
quests.name: Nyroth's Fragile Hope

quests.description:
The rot swallowed Nyroth's forging fire. Realizing the sickness is a living malice, he wants me to take the scorched scroll to the alchemist Jaime the Wandering Explorer.
I need to deliver the Scorched Arcon Scroll to Jaime the Wandering Explorer in Decayed Tunnel III to see if he can explain the living malice.
I delivered the scroll to Jaime the Wandering Explorer. He was fascinated by the volatile anomaly and agreed to investigate.
quests.name: Matters of the Heart
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Cape Accuracy Scroll: Intermediate (50%), Cape Accuracy Scroll: Greater (50%)

quests.description:
I need to let Jaime the Wandering Explorer analyze the scorched scroll to see if his alchemy can explain why Nyroth's machinery failed against the living malice.
Jaime the Wandering Explorer discovered the soil is skewed by rusted iron from Tristan's ancient battle with the Balrog. I must defeat 50 Echopuss to clear the toxic air.
I purged the Echopuss from the area honoring Tristan's memory and clearing the toxicity. But the living malice, Caligo, lies deeper.
quests.name: A Memory of Iron

quests.description:
I must find Daniel the Scholar in Precipice of Darkness and tell him that the iron corruption has been purged, making the tree bark pure enough for a magical seal.
Daniel the Scholar, a friendly mediator for the fairies, explained that the living malice Caligo has consumed the Arcon. To hide the fairies home from Caligo's gaze, he needs to cast an invisible Stasis Seal. I must gather 30 Cursed Dolls and 20 Duskmander Tails from the deeper chambers.
I delivered the catalysts to Daniel the Scholar, who successfully wove the invisible Stasis Seal. The corrupted beasts still roam, but the World Tree's roots have stopped decaying and the fairies are hidden from Caligo's sight. The true battle lies ahead, but we have bought them time.
quests.name: A Heart of Stillness and Wood
quests.requirements: Cursed Doll x 30, Duskmander Tail x 20

quests.description:
The Stasis Seal is only a temporary measure. Daniel the Scholar asked me to speak with him about warning the fairies on the surface.
I must travel back up to the Magic Library and deliver the truth to Grendel the Really Old before the Sages are caught completely off guard.
I returned to Ellinia and warned Grendel the Really Old. He was relieved to hear the Cave Fairies survived, but realized the Sages must prepare for the corrupted Arcon. He thanked me for buying them time.
quests.name: The Sage's Burden

quests.description:
A beautiful girl by the name of Riel from Florina Beach seems to be in need of help...
Riel introduced me to a part time job, where I have to collect 10 Coconuts. Why don't I start collecting those delicious looking Coconuts over there on the right
I brought back fresh Coconuts just like Riel said. Riel told me I can come back for work anytime I want. I guess I won't be starving here in Florina Beach.
quests.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach I

quests.description:
Riel in Florina Beach asks me a question about Florina Beach. Piece of cake. I can answer that before I start my work.
I have to prepare enough ingredients for 15 people and bring them to Riel in Florina Beach.
I answered all the questions that Riel gave me and passed her tests, then went to collect ingredients for 15 people.
quests.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach II
quests.requirements: Coconut x 15, Lupin's Banana x 15, Lorang Claw x 30

quests.description:
It seems that Riel in Florina Beach wants to ask for another favor.
I have to bring enough ingredients for 30 people to Riel in Florina Beach.
I worked a part-time gig gathering ingredients for meals for the tourists coming to Florina Beach.
quests.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach III
quests.requirements: Coconut x 30, Lupin's Banana x 30, Lorang Claw x 60, Clang Claw x 60

quests.description:
Riel is trying to develop a special dish in Florina Beach.
I need to collect ingredients that will help further cultivate the special taste of Florina Beach: 10 Coconuts, 10 Lorang Claws, 10 Clang Claws, and 10 Lupin's Bananas. Will Valen's new recipe succeed
I was familiar with working in Florina Beach, so I visited Riel one more time and helped her out. Why is she so desperate to help Valen
quests.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach IV
quests.requirements: Coconut x 10, Lupin's Banana x 10, Lorang Claw x 10, Clang Claw x 10

quests.description:
I heard there is an old man called Huckle inside a hidden secret room in Orbis Tower...
I met an old man named Huckle at the hidden room in the middle of Orbis Tower. He's been living in there for 30 years, studying the physics of the self-moving stones. He wants me to gather up 30 Jr. Sentinel Shellpieces, 15 Ice Sentinel Shellpieces, and 15 Fire Sentinel Shellpieces. Alright, let's do this...
I got Huckle, the old man living in the hidden room at the Orbis Tower, the items he had requested, and got Orbis Rock Scrolls in return. They allow me to teleport between the rocks at the 15th and 1st floors of Orbis Tower. Huckle looks like he needs more samples, so I guess I'll need to keep looking for them...
quests.name: Collecting Huckle's Magic Ingredients
quests.requirements: Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece x 30, Ice Sentinel Shellpiece x 15, Fire Sentinel Shellpiece x 15

Let's go see Master Sergeant Fox in El Nath.
Master Sergeant Fox, whom I met in El Nath, asked me to meet Staff Sergeant Charlie, Sergeant Bravo, and Corporal Easy in order, and then return. I should go find Staff Sergeant Charlie first, who is somewhere on the Ossyria. He said Staff Sergeant Charlie hates the cold, so he must have gone up the tower.
I found Staff Sergeant Charlie in Orbis!

quests.next_quest_name: A Request from Staff Sergeant Charlie

quests.description:
I should go see Alcaster of El Nath right now...
I met Alcaster the sorcerer at El Nath. He said he had heard about the Book of Ancient, written during a great war that happened hundreds of years ago. Interesting... The only living descendant of the author of The Book of Ancient is Hella, who lives in Orbis. I'd better go find her right now.
I found Hella's house, but unfortunately, she doesn't seem to be here. Only Elma the Housekeeper is there instead...
quests.name: The Descendent of the Author of the Book of Ancient
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I should probably go speak with Elma the Housekeeper in Hella's house over in Orbis.
Alcaster told me to go to Hella's house in Orbis, to no avail. She wasn't anywhere to be found, so I had to resort to talking to Elma the Housekeeper. According to her, Hella hadn't been home in months, and no one knows where she went or why. She did tell me to go see her best friend, Jade of El Nath, so I should go there immediately.
Jade... He looks a bit carefree, doesn't he I wonder if he actually knows anything about Hella.
quests.name: Hella's Missing
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I need to meet Hella's old friend, Jade, in El Nath.
Jade suspected that Hella may have gone on a search to find the keepsake of her late mother, and told me to go see Elma the Housekeeper again.
If it's Elma the Housekeeper, she should know about what was stolen from Hella, right
quests.name: Where's Hella?
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I should probably go speak with Elma the Housekeeper again in Hella's house over in Orbis.
Elma the Housekeeper told me she heard Hella mention something about an old lady. She also told me to go talk to Jade again if I want to know more about her.
I wonder if Jade knows anything about the old hag Hella mentioned.
quests.name: One Clue
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
To find Hella, I need to head back to El Nath and meet with Jade once again.
Jade said the "old lady" may be Spiruna, who lives in a small house around where the Orbis Park monsters walk around, and recommended that I go see her immediately.
What could Spiruna be doing in Orbis Park, where monsters roam around... I wonder if she knows anything about Hella.
quests.name: Looking For the Old Lady
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I need to meet Spiruna, who lives in a small house in Orbis Park.
Spiruna promised to tell me everything that she knows, as long as I find the Black Crystal that she lost in the snowfield while on a search for some materials for spells. Now where in the snowfield must that be...
I found a snow-covered rock in the snowfield. Could the Black Crystal be somewhere around here
quests.name: Spiruna's Black Crystal
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I need to find a Black Crystal somewhere in the El Nath snowfield.
I found Spiruna's Black Crystal underneath a rock at the snowfield, but it has some serious cracks on it. Anyway, I should give this back to Spiruna immediately.
Spiruna doesn't look too happy after receiving the Cracked Black Crystal. She's been like this ever since I found it... What if she gets mad
quests.name: The Cracked Black Crystal
quests.next_quest_name: How to Restore the Cracked Black Crystal
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
Spiruna, who lives in a small house in Orbis Park, seems to be quite angry.
Sure enough... Spiruna flew into a furious rage upon seeing the broken Black Crystal, doing nothing but yelling and blaming me. Why not ask the woman living with Spiruna for some help
Spiruna is shouting at the top of her lungs... What should I do The woman next to her seems unfazed... I wonder if she knows what to do in a situation like this
quests.name: How to Restore the Cracked Black Crystal
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I think I should ask for help from Spiruna's assistant, who lives in a small house in Orbis Park.
Spiruna's assistant quietly tells me that at this point, nothing will bring her back to her senses unless I bring an item called Fairy Dust, the only item that'll restore the cracked black crystal to its original state. Kriel the Fairy of Orbis Department Store may have it.
Fairies aren't exactly known for liking humans... I wonder if Kriel the Fairy will actually give me the Fairy Dust
quests.name: A Word from the Assistant
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I need to go meet Kriel the Fairy in the Orbis Department Store.
Kriel the Fairy wanted to make a deal with me, and I complied. For her to give me the Fairy Dust, I'll have to get her 100 Star Pixie's Starpieces, 50 Lunar Pixie's Moonpieces, and 30 Luster Pixie's Sunpieces. I'll have to go on a serious Pixie hunting spree...
I gave all the ingredients to Kriel the Fairy, so she will give me the Fairy Dust.
quests.name: To Acquire the Fairy Dust
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.requirements: Star Pixie's Starpiece x 100, Lunar Pixie's Moonpiece x 50, Luster Pixie's Sunpiece x 30
quests.rewards_items: 10x Blue Potion, 5x Return Scroll to Orbis

quests.description:
I need to go meet Kriel the Fairy in the Orbis Department Store.
I got Kriel the Fairy all the items she asked for and got the Fairy Dust in return. Now all I need to do is get this to Spiruna and see what happens.
I gave the Fairy Dust to Spiruna. Her attitude changed the moment she received it... Will she tell me about Hella now
quests.name: Acquiring the Fairy Dust
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.rewards_items:

quests.description:
I need to meet Spiruna, who lives in a small house in Orbis Park.
Spiruna was utterly ecstatic over receiving the Fairy Dust, and proceeded to tell me everything she knew about Hella. Oh my goodness... are you kidding me That assistant there is the Hella I've been looking for all this time
Hella turned out to be none other than Spiruna's assistant! Unbelievable! I should have asked for her name first!
quests.name: The Truth Revealed
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I need to meet Hella, the assistant of Spiruna, who lives in a small house in Orbis Park.
Hella requested that I give Hella's Pendant to Jade. She also mentioned something about an old diary that she found at home years ago, and how it mentioned the existence of The Book of Ancient and that the owner lost it somewhere deep in the valley of the snowfield. Jade should be able to fill in the rest for me. I should go see him right now and inform him of her whereabouts.
I delivered Hella's Pendant to Jade.
quests.name: Hella is Found!
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Shoes Jump Scroll: Intermediate (25%), Shoes Jump Scroll: Greater (25%), Shoes Speed Scroll: Intermediate (25%), Shoes Speed Scroll: Greater (25%)

quests.description:
I need to speak with Jade in El Nath to find the next clue.
I gave Jade the pendant from Hella, and I could immediately sense that he was pleased to know that his friend is all right after all. That Small Tomb Jade mentioned should be somewhere in the snowfield.
A small tomb... so shabby and neglected... Could the key to The Book of Ancient really be in a place like this...
quests.name: The Small Grave That's Hidden
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I think I should investigate the Small Tomb found in Wolf Territory I in more detail.
I found someone's grave somewhere deep in the valley of the snowfield. I also removed an old ring from the corpse's finger. Maybe Alcaster knows what to do with it.
I handed over the Old Ring to Alcaster.
quests.name: An Old Ring
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
It seems like Alcaster in El Nath wants to unravel the secret of the Old Ring.
Alcaster took time observing the Old Ring, and felt an incredible force emanating from it. He recommended that I go see Scadur the Hunter around El Nath.
Scadur seemed to know something after receiving the Old Ring.
quests.name: The Secrets Behind the Ring?
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
To find out about the Old Ring, I think I should first do a favor for Scadur in El Nath.
Scadur mentioned that the price of wolf skin has gone through the roof these days, and wanted to make a deal with me. 100 Hector Tails and 100 White Fang Tails will be enough for him to return the ring to me and tell me everything he knows about it.
Satisfied with the Hector Tails and White Fang Tails, Scadur said he would give the ring back.
quests.name: Collecting Wolf Skin
quests.next_quest_name: Looking for the Sage in Perion
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.requirements: Hector Tail x 100, White Fang Tail x 100

quests.description:
I think I should meet Scadur in El Nath and ask about Old Ring.
Scadur reminisced about the old days, when he heard about the ring from the four sages he met as a young man. He recommended that I visit Victoria Island and meet up with all four of the sages, starting with the one in Perion.
I met Dances with Balrog, one of the four sages of Victoria Island. He looks incredibly rough for a sage... Will he actually know anything about the Old Ring
quests.name: Looking for the Sage in Perion
quests.next_quest_name: Dances with Balrog and His Recovery
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I should listen to the story of Dances with Balrog, one of the four sages, in Perion of Victoria Island.
I talked to the sage Dances with Balrog in Perion about the ring, and he told me that he has an item that could serve as a clue to finding The Book of Ancient. However, he said he can't just give it to me... I managed to make a promise that he would hand over the clue if I bring him 2 Power Crystals, items that can help him restore his strength.
I brought the Power Crystals to Dances with Balrog.
quests.name: Dances with Balrog and His Recovery
quests.next_quest_name: Looking for the Sage in Ellinia
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I should listen to the story of Dances with Balrog, one of the four sages, in Perion of Victoria Island.
I handed over 2 Power Crystals to Dances with Balrog and received an Old Map Piece (1/4). The map was split into four pieces and entrusted to the four sages, and I was asked to collect all the map pieces to find and seal The Book of Ancient. Now, I should go meet the sage in Ellinia...
I met Grendel the Really Old, one of the four sages of Victoria Island. It feels like this person might know something about The Book of Ancient.
quests.name: Looking for the Sage in Ellinia
quests.next_quest_name: Grendel the Really Old and His Recovery
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I should listen to the story of Grendel the Really Old, one of the four sages, in Ellinia of Victoria Island.
The sage of Ellinia, Grendel the Really Old, promised to give me the map piece in exchange for 2 Wisdom Crystals.
I gave Grendel the Really Old the Wisdom Crystals. Now I can get the map piece.
quests.name: Grendel the Really Old and His Recovery
quests.next_quest_name: Looking for the Sage in Henesys
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I should listen to the story of Grendel the Really Old, one of the four sages, in Ellinia of Victoria Island.
I handed 2 Wisdom Crystals over to Grendel the Really Old and received the second Old Map Piece (2/4). Now, I should head out to meet the sage in Henesys...
A person whose eyes carry the weight of many years, contrasting with her youthful appearance... that's the impression I got from Athena Pierce, the sage of Henesys.
quests.name: Looking for the Sage in Henesys
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I should listen to the story of Athena Pierce, one of the four sages, in Henesys of Victoria Island.
The sage of Henesys, Athena Pierce, promised to give me the old piece of map in exchange for 2 Dexterity Crystals.
I handed the Dexterity Crystals to Athena Pierce. Now I should be able to get the third old map piece, right
quests.name: Athena Pierce and Her Recovery
quests.next_quest_name: Looking for the Sage in Kerning City
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I should listen to the story of Athena Pierce, one of the four sages, in Henesys of Victoria Island.
I handed 2 Dexterity Crystals over to Athena Pierce and received the third old map piece. Now, all I have to do is meet the sage in Kerning City, right
I met Dark Lord, the sage who lives in seclusion in Kerning City.
quests.name: Looking for the Sage in Kerning City
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I should listen to the story of Dark Lord, one of the four sages, in Kerning City of Victoria Island.
The sage of Kerning City, Dark Lord, promised to give me the map piece in exchange for 2 Luck Crystals.
I handed the Luck Crystals over to Dark Lord. Have I gathered all the map pieces now
quests.name: Dark Lord and His Recovery
quests.next_quest_name: All the Map Pieces in One Place
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I should listen to the story of Dark Lord, one of the four sages, in Kerning City of Victoria Island.
I obtained the Old Map Piece (4/4) from the four sages in Victoria Island, and this map supposedly locates where The Book of Ancient is currently hidden. I should get back to Alcaster now.
If it's Alcaster, he will surely know what to do with the Old Map Piece (4/4).
quests.name: All the Map Pieces in One Place
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
Let's talk to Alcaster of Henesys about the Old Map Piece (4/4).
So I need the Memory Powder to put the map pieces back together... I better talk to Corporal Easy of the Alpha Platoon and see if he has it.
If it is Corporal Easy, he should have the Memory Powder...
quests.name: Restoring the Map
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
Let's go meet Corporal Easy in Cloud Park VI.
I made a promise with Corporal Easy that he will hand over the Memory Powder if I bring him 50 Zombie's Lost Tooths and 50 Zombie's Lost Gold Tooths. It seems like they can be obtained from monsters beyond the snowfield valley...
I handed over all the items to Corporal Easy.
quests.name: Acquiring the Memory Powder
quests.next_quest_name: The Map is in One Piece
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.requirements: Zombie's Lost Tooth x 50, Zombie's Lost Gold Tooth x 50

quests.description:
Let's go meet Corporal Easy in Cloud Park VI.
I got the Memory Powder from Corporal Easy. Now I need to get this to Alcaster.
I handed the Memory Powder received from Corporal Easy to Alcaster. Alcaster seems to be trying to use a special magic.
quests.name: The Map is in One Piece
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
It seems that Alcaster of El Nath has finally succeeded in making the map.
With the Memory Powder, Alcaster was able to attach the four map pieces and turn it into a map. According to the map, The Book of Ancient lies somewhere around Orbis Tower at some Statue.
I opened the Statue of the Orbis Tower with the Old Ring. I wonder if the The Book of Ancient is really there
quests.name: The Secrets Behind the Statue
quests.next_quest_name: The Book of Ancient is Back!
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.description:
I need to investigate the Statue in Orbis Tower <6th Floor>.
I can't believe I finally have The Book of Ancient. Now I need to turn this over to Alcaster...
A lot of time and effort was put into this, but The Book of Ancient is finally back in Alcaster's hands, and he will begin working on the process of sealing the book for good. As a sign of appreciation, he rewarded me with a special cape. I really hope he finds a way to seal the book for good.
quests.name: The Book of Ancient is Back!
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.rewards_items:
Pick one:
Any Class: Blue Magic Cape, Red Magic Cape, White Magic Cape, Black Magic Cape

quests.description:
I should go check up on Alcaster in El Nath soon.
Alcaster of El Nath told me in order to seal The Book of Ancient, he'll need a Dark Crystal and a Star Rock. So here I am, looking for them. The Dark Crystal is supposedly only found from evil-minded monsters, and the ores can be refined by Spiruna in Orbis Park.
I got Alcaster the Dark Crystal and the Star Rock. He may have been drained and exhausted from sealing up The Book of Ancient, but his heart seems to be at peace.
quests.name: Alcaster and the Dark Crystal
quests.requirements: Dark Crystal x 1, Star Rock x 1

quests.description:
I should go see Scadur the Hunter in El Nath.
I got to see Scadur the Hunter, who previously aided me in finding The Book of Ancient requested by Alcaster. Long ago, he lost his wife when monsters from the Dead Mine raided the town. Now, his son, Nick, has ventured into the depths of the Dead Mine, vowing to defeat the monsters, but he has yet to return... Scadur has asked me to search for Nick's Ring, a keepsake that might be lost somewhere inside the lava cave deep within the Dead Mine. On top of that, he wants me to honor his son's wish by defeating Cerebes as well...! This promises to be quite a perilous journey.
I went into the innermost part of the lava cave, where I found a Piece of Statue. I have a feeling something is in here.
quests.name: Traces of Nick
quests.parent: Nick, the Son of Scadur the Hunter

quests.description:
Let's investigate the Piece of Statue in Cave Within the Cave.
At the bottom of a chipped part of the statue was what appeared to be Nick's Ring. A name is engraved on it, and I suppose Scadur can read out the name for me.
I found Nick's Ring at the lava cave, and I also collected a number of Cerebes Tooth, and gave them all to Piece of Statue. Hopefully Nick will be satisfied with this. I got a cape from Piece of Statue that's been passed down from generation to generation... this ain't bad at all!
quests.name: Nick's Ring
quests.parent: Nick, the Son of Scadur the Hunter
quests.requirements: Defeat Cerebes x 150, Nick's Ring x 1, Cerebes Tooth x 100
quests.rewards_items:
Pick one:
Any Class: Blue Gaia Cape, Red Gaia Cape, White Gaia Cape, Black Gaia Cape

quests.description:
Having reached level 30 and mastered the way of the Swordsman, I feel the urge to learn even more.
Does Dances with Balrog of Perion have even greater lessons to teach me
Dances with Balrog of Perion seemed surprised to see how much stronger I had become compared to before.
quests.name: The Warrior's Next Journey

quests.description:
Dances with Balrog in Perion wants to test whether I'm worthy of receiving his teachings.
Perion's Dances with Balrog gave me a letter to deliver to the Warrior Job Instructor, who I should be able to find somewhere in West Rocky Mountain IV. He said I'd learn the rest of the details there.
In West Rocky Mountain IV, I met Warrior Job Instructor. He said he would test whether I was worthy of making the 2nd job advancement. Great! I told him I was ready for anything!
quests.name: Finding the Instructor

quests.description:
The Warrior Job Instructor at West Rocky Mountain IV seems ready to give me a test to prove whether I deserve to become stronger.
The Warrior Job Instructor at West Rocky Mountain IV gave me my mission: enter a hidden area, defeat the monsters there, and collect Black Marbles.
I passed the Warrior Job Instructor's test in West Rocky Mountain IV!
quests.name: Test of Qualification

quests.description:
Now that I've passed the Warrior Job Instructor's test, I should have proven my strength!
I received The Proof of a Hero for successfully passing the Warrior Job Instructor's test. I should return to Dances with Balrog in Perion now.
Dances with Balrog in Perion welcomed me warmly, and I gained a new job, obtaining even greater power!
quests.name: Proof of Qualification
quests.requirements: The Proof of a Hero x 1

Having reached level 30 and mastered the way of the Magician, I feel the urge to learn more.
Does Grendel the Really Old of Ellinia have even greater lessons to teach me
Grendel the Really Old said that if I can pass his test, he'll gladly teach me more. I'm no longer the weakling I once was, but hearing that I still have to face a trial makes me a bit nervous.
quests.name: The Magician's Next Journey

It seems like Bruce, your neighbor living in Henesys, has something on his mind.
Bruce, your neighbor living in Henesys, has been agonizing over how to get his newly found daughter, Ayan, to open her heart to him. It might be best to seek advice from Mrs. Ming Ming. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I met with Mrs. Ming Ming to find a way for Bruce, my neighbor living in Henesys, to become closer and open up with his daughter, Ayan.
quests.name: Bruce's Dilemma

quests.description:
I need to seek advice from Mrs. Ming Ming on behalf of Bruce in Henesys.
Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys advised that it is crucial for Bruce to convey his true feelings to his daughter, and suggested that preparing a homemade dish for her would be a great idea. Since Bruce isn't good at cooking, she asked me to deliver a recipe for a dish that Ayan would love. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered the recipe written by Mrs. Ming Ming to Bruce.
quests.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Advice

I brought Bruce in Henesys the ingredients to finish the dish for his daughter. Now all I can do is hope he finishes cooking it well.
quests.name: Bruce's Cooking Ingredients
quests.next_quest_name: A Father's Love for His Daughter
quests.requirements: Firewood x 15, Egg x 3, Apple x 3, Orange x 3

quests.description:
It seems Bruce in Henesys wants to express his feelings to his daughter.
Bruce in Henesys asked me to deliver his homemade Bruce's Special Cake to Ayan in Perion. It would be better if he delivered it himself, but... I can understand him being shy. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered Bruce's Special Cake to Ayan in Perion. It seems Ayan felt Bruce's sincerity after eating the dish.
quests.name: A Father's Love for His Daughter

quests.description:
It seems Ayan in Perion was moved by her dad's cooking.
After eating her dad's food, I think Ayan in Perion came to understand his true feelings. She then asked me to convey her feelings to Bruce in Henesys. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered the heartfelt message from his daughter, Ayan, to Bruce in Henesys. It might take time, but I feel like these two will be able to live happily together from now on.

quests.description:
Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys seems to have something on her mind.
Mrs. Ming Ming mentioned that although the town festival was a huge success, Chief Stan hasn't been feeling quite like himself lately. She asked for help finding a way to cheer him up, suggesting that Jay, who is well-versed in ancient history, might know something. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
I went to see Jay in Henesys to seek advice on how to raise Chief Stan's spirits.
quests.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Concern

quests.description:
Jay of Henesys seems to know a way for Chief Stan to regain his vitality.
Jay of Henesys mentioned that Chief Stan was an adventurer who traveled the world in the past, and suggested that if he could find the Old Chief Stan's Hammer lost long ago when he was young, he might regain his energy. I should inform Mrs. Ming Ming of this information. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
I passed on Jay's advice to Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys.
quests.name: Chief Stan's Past

quests.description:
Jay of Henesys seems to have another request.
Jay of Henesys asked me to look for the Old Chief Stan's Hammer for Chief Stan. Will I be able to find it while hunting Evil Eye deep inside the Ant Tunnel Nothing is certain, but if I ever get the chance to go to the Ant Tunnel, I should look for it. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
I hunted Evil Eye deep inside the Ant Tunnel and finally found the Old Chief Stan's Hammer. I thought it couldn't be found since it was lost decades ago... By the way, Chief Stan really must have been an adventurer in the past.
quests.name: Chief Stan's Hammer

quests.description:
Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys seems to want to deliver good news to Chief Stan.
Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys asked me to deliver the freshly polished Chief Stan's Hammer to Chief Stan. She seems a bit cautious about handing it over herself.
I delivered the Chief Stan's Hammer to Chief Stan of Henesys, and he was extremely surprised yet overjoyed. Seeing his eyes sparkle like that, it looks as though he might set off on an adventure again right this moment! At any rate, I should report all of this back to Mrs. Ming Ming. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
quests.name: Memories of Youth

quests.description:

I delivered Chief Stan's message to Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys. She seems relieved and ready to prepare for the next town festival.

quests.description:
It seems like Jake, who works at the subway entrance in Kerning City, has something on his mind.
It seems like Jake, who works at the subway entrance in Kerning City, needs Mong from Kong's help to cure his fear of Stirge. I should ask Mong from Kong in Kerning City if there is a good way. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I went to see Mong from Kong to help cure the fear of Stirge that Jake, who works at the subway entrance in Kerning City, is suffering from.
quests.name: Stirge Phobia

quests.description:
Mong from Kong in Kerning City might know about a cure for a phobia of Stirge.
I have my doubts about whether Mong from Kong in Kerning City truly knows anything about Stirge, but as he says, I should look for the materials needed to craft the medicine. I need to defeat Bubbling and Stirge around Kerning City and collect 10 Bubbling's Huge Bubbles and 10 Stirge Wings. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered the materials required to craft the medicine for the Stirge phobia to Mong from Kong in Kerning City.
quests.name: Making the Medicine
quests.next_quest_name: The Final Ingredient for the Cure
quests.requirements: Bubbling's Huge Bubble x 10, Stirge Wing x 10

quests.description:
It seems like Mong from Kong in Kerning City still needs something else.
Claiming that he needs the final ingredient for the Stirge phobia cure, Mong from Kong in Kerning City asked me to go get a Vitamin Gummy from his grandfather, Mr. Goldstein in Lith Harbor. To think that Mr. Goldstein was Mong from Kong's grandfather... Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
Mr. Goldstein in Lith Harbor handed over the Vitamin Gummy with a suspicious look. Will this really be, okay
quests.name: The Final Ingredient for the Cure

quests.description:
It seems like Mr. Goldstein in Lith Harbor is willing to grant his grandson's request.
I obtained the final ingredient for the Stirge phobia cure, the Vitamin Gummy, from Mr. Goldstein in Lith Harbor. Now, all I need to do is bring this to Mong from Kong in Kerning City. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered all the ingredients for the Stirge phobia cure to Mong from Kong in Kerning City. Now, I can only hope that he crafts the cure properly.
quests.name: Grandfather's Vitamin Gummy

quests.description:
It seems like Mong from Kong in Kerning City has finally crafted the Stirge phobia cure.
I need to deliver the Special Stirge Phobia Cure crafted by Mong from Kong to Jake at the subway entrance in Kerning City. I hope this helps... Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered the Special Stirge Phobia Cure crafted by Mong from Kong to Jake at the subway entrance in Kerning City. Truth be told, it seems like a medicine with little to no actual effect, but if it gave Jake the courage he needed, perhaps that is enough.
quests.name: It's All in the Mind

quests.description:
I met a fairy in Ellinia that was busily studying the magic of life. Her name was Mar, and she took a look at the lifeless doll that was once my pet for me. She can bring it back to life with a Water of Life and a Life Scroll. I hear that she knows Cloy of Henesys... A pet trainer named Trainer Bartos in Henesys might know something about the scroll of life, so I should start there...
After easily passing the test Trainer Bartos of Henesys gave me, I got a hold of the Water of Life and Life Scroll and got them to Mar the Fairy. With her magical power and the items I got her, she turned the doll back into a living pet. I can hang out with him for a while longer now... Sweet...
quests.name: "Mar" the Fairy and the Water of Life

quests.description:
It seems that Casey in Henesys Park knows a way to have a different kind of fun in Maple World.
I met Casey in Henesys Park. He claimed he could make me something to entertain myself whenever I got tired of hunting if I brought him enough Monster Cards. Getting them should be easy. I just have to defeat any of the following monsters, scattered across Maple World: Blue Snail, Pig, Ribbon Pig, Octopus, Blue Mushroom, Horny Mushroom, Evil Eye, Curse Eye, Lupin, Cold Eye, Lorang, Tortie, Wraith, Drake, or Wild Kargo. I should try to gather them when I have time.
I brought the requested items to Casey in Henesys Park and received a Set of Match Cards! With this, I can play the Match Cards mini-game with other adventurers anywhere! I should remember to ask Casey if I want to know more about the mini-game.
quests.name: Make a Match Cards Set
quests.parent: Maple World's Unique Fun: Match Cards

quests.description:
It seems that Casey in Henesys Park knows a way to have a different kind of fun in Maple World.
I met Casey in Henesys Park. He claimed he could make me something to entertain myself whenever I got tired of hunting and asked me to collect a few items. He said I can get them by defeating Stump, Slime, and Orange Mushroom, found around Henesys. I should try to gather them when I have the time.
I brought the requested items to Casey in Henesys Park and received a Slime & Mushroom Omok Set! With this, I can play the Omok mini-game with other adventurers anywhere! I should remember to ask Casey if I want to know more about the mini-game.

quests.description:
The master blacksmith of Perion, Silas Irons, seems to be looking for someone worthy of becoming his apprentice.
The master blacksmith of Perion, Silas Irons, is giving me a test to see if I'm fit to become his apprentice. He said that a true blacksmith must have the required amount of strength and knowledge. He told me to defeat the monsters around Perion and bring back the raw ore they drop.
I passed the test given by Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion. Does this mean I can become a true blacksmith in Maple World
quests.name: Silas Irons in Need of an Apprentice
quests.requirements: Defeat Stump x 20, Defeat Dark Stump x 20, Bronze Ore x 5

quests.description:
It looks like Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, is finally ready to acknowledge my skills.
Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, was impressed by how much I've grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat Dark Axe Stumps and Zombie Mushrooms, then create an Orihalcon Ingot and a Gold Ingot and bring them back to him.
Silas Irons, the master craftsman of Perion, was amazed by my work and handed me a Armor Crafting Catalyst. It seems to be a special item that can be used during crafting to alter the stats of equipment. Maybe I should give it a try.
quests.name: A Blacksmith in My Own Right!
quests.requirements: Smithing Lv. 5 or higher, Defeat Dark Axe Stump x 30, Defeat Zombie Mushroom x 30, Orihalcon Ingot x 1, Gold Ingot x 1

quests.description:
It looks like Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, needs some help. Maybe I should go check in on him.
Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, received an important request, but he's been struggling because he's short on materials. I need to defeat Bubblings and bring back Mithril Ingot to help him out.
I delivered the items Silas Irons requested without any issues. At this rate, I might really be considered a fine apprentice.
quests.name: Silas Irons in Need of Help
quests.requirements: Smithing Lv. 2 or higher, Defeat Bubbling x 25, Mithril Ingot x 1

quests.description:
It seems Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, is looking for someone worthy of becoming his apprentice.
Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, gave me a test when I asked to become his apprentice. He said that weapon crafting requires one to have the proper amount of strength and knowledge. He told me to use my Smithing skill to craft 1 Bronze Ingot and 1 Iron Ingot. As long as I have the materials, those shouldn't be too difficult to make.
I passed the test Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, gave me. Does this mean I can now become a true weapon craftsman of Maple World
quests.name: Mr. Thunder in Need of an Apprentice
quests.requirements: Bronze Ingot x 1, Iron Ingot x 1

quests.description:
It seems Mr. Thunder, the master weaponcrafter of Perion, is finally ready to acknowledge my weaponcrafting skills.
Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, was amazed by my growth and suggested that I show off my skills. I need to defeat Iron Hogs and craft 1 Monkey Wrench to bring back to him.
Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, was impressed by my craftsmanship and handed me a One-Handed Weapon Crafting Catalyst. It looks like a special item that can change an equipment's stats when used during crafting. Maybe I should try it out.
quests.name: A Weaponcrafter in My Own Right!
quests.requirements: Weaponcrafting Lv. 5 or higher, Defeat Iron Hog x 30, Monkey Wrench x 1

quests.description:
It looks like Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, could use some help. Maybe I should go check in on him.
Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, received an important request, but he's been having trouble because he's short on materials. I'll need to defeat some Axe Stumps and craft 10 Screws to help him out.
I was able to deliver the items Mr. Thunder asked for without any issues. At this rate, I might really be considered a fine apprentice.
quests.name: Mr. Thunder in Need of Help
quests.requirements: Weaponcrafting Lv. 2 or higher, Defeat Axe Stump x 25, Screw x 10

quests.description:
It seems Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, is looking for someone worthy of becoming his apprentice.
After I told Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, that I want to become his apprentice, he gave me a test. He told me tailoring requires one to have the right balance of skill and knowledge and asked me to defeat monsters near Ellinia and collect Leafs.
I passed the test given by Francois, the tailor of Ellinia. Does this mean I can now become a proper tailor of Maple World
quests.name: Francois in Need of an Apprentice
quests.requirements: Defeat Dark Stump x 30, Leaf x 20

quests.description:
It seems Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, is finally ready to acknowledge my tailoring skills.
Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, was impressed by how much I've grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat Wild Boars and craft 1 Red Starry Bandana to bring back to him.
Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, admired my craftsmanship and handed me a Armor Crafting Catalyst. It seems to be a special item that can alter an equipment's stats when used during crafting. Maybe I should give it a try.
quests.name: A Tailor in My Own Right!
quests.requirements: Tailoring Lv. 5 or higher, Defeat Wild Boar x 30, Red Starry Bandana x 1

quests.description:
It looks like Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, could use some help. Maybe I should stop by after a while.
Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, received an important request, but he's been struggling due to a lack of materials. I need to defeat Green Mushrooms and craft 10 Spool of Thread to help him out.
I was able to safely deliver the item Francois asked for. At this point, I'd say I've proven myself to be a pretty solid apprentice.
quests.name: Francois in Need of Help
quests.requirements: Tailoring Lv. 2 or higher, Defeat Green Mushroom x 25, Spool of Thread x 10

I passed the test given by Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys. Does this mean I can now become a proper carpenter in Maple World

quests.requirements: Defeat Stump x 30, Tree Branch x 20

quests.description:
It seems Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, is finally ready to acknowledge my woodworking skills.
Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, was impressed by how much I've grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat Dark Axe Stumps and craft The Red Relaxer to bring back to him.
Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, admired my craftsmanship and handed me a Two-Handed Weapon Crafting Catalyst. It seems to be a special item that can be used during crafting to alter an equipment's stats. Maybe I should give it a try.
quests.name: A Carpenter in My Own Right!
quests.requirements: Woodcrafting Lv. 5 or higher, Defeat Dark Axe Stump x 30, The Red Relaxer x 1

quests.description:
The leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City seems to be looking for someone who could become his business partner.
The leatherworking master, JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City, is giving me a test to see if I'm worthy of becoming his partner. He said that one must have the proper strength and knowledge for leatherworking and asked me to defeat monsters around Kerning City and Henesys to collect Leather.
I passed the test given by the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City. Could this mean that I, too, can stand proudly as a leatherworker of Maple World
quests.name: JM From tha Streetz Looking for a Partner

quests.description:
It seems the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City is finally ready to acknowledge my leatherworking skills.
Impressed by my growth, the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City suggested that I showcase what I'm capable of. I need to defeat Wild Boars and craft 1 Red Chair, then bring it back.
Amazed by my craftsmanship, the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City handed me a Armor Crafting Catalyst. It seems to be a special item that can be used during crafting to alter equipment stats. Should I try using it
quests.name: A Leatherworker in My Own Right!
quests.requirements: Leatherworking Lv. 5 or higher, Defeat Wild Boar x 30, Red Chair x 1

quests.description:
It looks like the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City needs help again. It's been a while, perhaps I should pay him a visit.
The leatherworking master, JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City, received an important request, but he's been struggling due to a lack of materials. To help him, I'll need to defeat Jr. Neckis and gather Jr. Necki Skins.
I was able to safely deliver the items requested by the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City. At this point, wouldn't I qualify as a reliable partner
quests.name: JM From tha Streetz in Need of Help
quests.requirements: Leatherworking Lv. 2 or higher, Defeat Jr. Necki x 25, Jr. Necki Skin x 10

The Arcforging master, Chrishrama of Sleepywood, gave me a test after I asked to become his apprentice. He said true Arcforgers must possess great wisdom and instructed me to defeat monsters around Sleepywood and collect 1 Garnet Ore.
I passed the test given by the Arcforging master, Chrishrama of Sleepywood. Does this mean I can finally stand as a true Arcforger of Maple World
quests.name: Chrishrama in Need of an Apprentice
quests.requirements: Defeat Dark Stump x 30, Garnet Ore x 1

quests.description:
It seems the Arcforging master Chrishrama of Sleepywood is finally ready to recognize my Arcforging skills.
The Arcforging master, Chrishrama of Sleepywood, was impressed with my growth and challenged me to prove my skill. I need to defeat Horny Mushrooms and craft 1 Topaz to bring back to him.
Amazed by my craftsmanship, the Arcforging master Chrishrama of Sleepywood handed me a Scroll Crafting Catalyst. It appears to be a special item that can be used during crafting to create even stronger scrolls. Should I give it a try
quests.name: An Arcforger in My Own Right!
quests.requirements: Arcforge Lv. 5 or higher, Defeat Horny Mushroom x 30, Topaz x 1

quests.description:

quests.name: Chrishrama in Need of Help
